he ṛye stuvataḥ stutiṃ kurvataḥ asya yajamānasya yāmati yajñe bhojān dātṛn marutaḥ stuhi |
tṛṇādibhakṣaṇāya gacchantyaḥ gāvo yathā ramante tadvanmaruto'pi raṇan ramantām |
yataḥ gacchanto marutaḥ pṛrvān purātanān sakhān iva anu hya āhvaya |
kāminaḥ mṛtīcchāvato marutaḥ girā stutyā gṛṇīhi stuhi ||
‘pra śardhāya’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ śyāvāśvasyārṣaṃ maruddevatākam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava ityaindrīmanūcya mārutyā yajet’ ( āśva. śrau. 2. 11 ) iti ||
pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava imāṃ vāca
tāyamāno megho marutṇo vā ᵥvāśati śabdayati |
tadā ᵥāpaḥ ᵥparijayaḥ parito gandhya āpaḥ ᵥavanā avanī bhūmau ᵥsvaranti adhaḥ patanti ||
‘vidyunmahasaḥ’ iti tṛtīyā kārīyamiba dvitīyasyāḥ piṇḍyā yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca- ‘vidyunmahaso naro'madidyavaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇāḥ ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 13 ) iti ||
vidyunmahaso naro aśmadidyavo vātatviṣo marutaḥ parvatacyutaḥ |
abdyā cinmuhurā hādunīvṛtaḥ stanaryadamā rabhasā udaujasaḥ ||
vidyut'mahasaḥ | naraḥ | aśmadidyavaḥ | vāta'tviṣaḥ | marutaḥ | parvata'cyutaḥ | abdyā | cit | muhuḥ | ā | hāduni'vṛtaḥ | stanayat'amāḥ | rabhasāḥ | ut'ojasaḥ ||3||

ᵥvidyunmahasaḥ vidyunmānatejasaḥ ᵥnaraḥ vṛṣṭyādernetāraḥ ᵥaśmadidyavaḥ vyāsāyudhā aśmasāra- mayāyudhā vā ᵥvātatviṣaḥ prāptadīptayaḥ ᵥparvatacyutaḥ parvatānāṃ meghānāṃ vā cyāvayitāraḥ ᵥabdyā ᵥmuhuḥ udakānāṃ dātāraḥ ||
ᵥrabhasāḥ vṛṣṭyarthamu- dyujñānāḥ ᵥudaujasaḥ udgatabalāḥᵡ ᵥmarutaḥ vṛṣṭyarthaṃ prādurbhavantītyarthaḥ ||
vya̭ktṷrbu॒drā vya̭hā̭ni॒ śika̭so॒ vya̭nta̭rikṣa॒ṃ vi ra॒jāṃsi̭ dhūtayaḥ |
vi yada॒jñā~ a̭ja̭tha॒ nāva̭ṃ ī॒ṃ yathā॒ vi du॒rgāṇi̭ ma॒ruto॒ nāha̭ riṣyatha ||
vi | aktūn | rudrāḥ | vi | ahāni | śikasaḥ | vi | antarikṣam | vi | rajāṃsi | dhūtayaḥ | vi | yat | ajñān | ajatha | nāvam | īm | yathā | vi | duḥ'gāni | marutaḥ | na | aha | riṣyatha || 4 ||
he ᵥrudrāḥ rudraputrā marutaḥ ᵥaktūn rātrīḥ ᵥvi ajatha ityuttarādhagatena saṃbadhyate |
he ᵥśikasaḥ śaktāḥ sarvamapi kartum ᵥantarikṣaṃ ᵥvi ajatha |
he ᵥdhūtayaḥ kampakāḥ ᵥyat yadā ᵥajñān meghān ᵥvi ᵥajathaᵡ gamayatha ᵥnāvam ᵥīṃ tāḥ ᵥyathā samudraṃ tadvat ᵥdurgāṇi śatrungarāṇi ᵥvi ajatha he ᵥmaruto ᵥnāha ᵥriṣyatha naiva hiṃsatha ||
tadvīryaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ tatān sūryo na yojanam |
etā na yāme argṛbhītaśociṣo'naśdāṃ yatayatānā girima ||
tat | vīryam | vaḥ | marutaḥ | mahi'tvanam | dīrgham | tatān | sūryaḥ | na | yojanam | etāḥ | na | yāme | argṛbhīta'śociṣaḥ | anaś'dām | yat | ni | aryātan | girima || 5 ||
he marutaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ tadvīryaṃ prasiddhaṃ sāmarthyaṃ mahitvanaṃ mahattvaṃ dīrgham atyantamāyataṃ tatāna tanoti |
loke sūryo na yojanaṃ sūryasteja iva |
te yathā yāme gamane yojanaṃ dīrghaṃ tanvanti tadvadvīryaparo dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
he maruto yūyamagṛbhītaśociṣaḥ santaḥ yat yadā anaśdāṃ vyāpakadakadātāraṃ paṇibhirapahatānāmaśvānāmpradātāraṃ vā giriṃ meghaṃ parvataṃ vā nyayātan nihatavantaḥ stha ||
atrāji śardho maruto yadarṇasaṃ morṣathā vṛkṣaṃ kapaneva vedhasaḥ |
adha smā no aramatiṃ sajoṣasaścuriva yantamanu neṣathā sugam ||
atrāji | śardhaḥ | marutaḥ | yat | arṇasam | morṣatha | vṛkṣam | kapana'iva | vedhasaḥ | adha | sma | naḥ | aramatim | sa'joṣasaḥ | cakṣuḥ'iva | yantam | anu | neṣatha | su'gam || 6 ||

he vedhasaḥ vṛṣṭividhātāro he marutaḥ śardhaḥ bhavatāṃ gaṇam atrāji ājate | yat yasmāt arṇasam udakavantaṃ vṛkṣam | vṛśyate vidārayata iti vṛkṣo meghaḥ | taṃ mopatha tāḍayathetyarthaḥ | kapaneva | ityayanarthakaḥ | kampanāḥ santaḥ | yadvā | kapanāḥ kramayo vṛkṣaṃ ghṛṇādayaḥ | te yathā muṣṇanti tadvat | adha api ca | sma iti pūraṇaḥ | naḥ asmān | māmityarthaḥ | he sajoṣasaḥ yuṣmāsu parasparaṃ samānaprītayo yūyama aramatim āramaṇaṃ dhanādikaṃ prati yantaṃ gacchantam anu nepatha anukrameṇa nayatha sugaṃ sugamanaṃ mārgam | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | cakṣuriva | tadyathā mārgapradarśanena nāyakaḥ bhavati tadvat ||
2. kha-ca-ṇa-te yajanam; jha-na-bha-me yajanam; ra-yāme yajanam; śa-yāme gamanāya yojanam |
na sa jīyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyati |
nāsya rāya upa dasyanti notaya ṛrṣi vā yaṃ rājānaṃ vā suṣūdatha ||
na | saḥ | jīyate | marutaḥ | na | hanyate | na | sredhati | na | vyathate | na | riṣyati | na | asya | rāyaḥ | upa | dasyanti | na | ūtayaḥ | ṛrṣim | vā | yam | rājānam | vā | suṣūdatha || 7 ||
ha ˅marutaḥ yūyaṃ ˅yam ˅ṛrṣi mantradraṣṭāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ˅rājānaṃ ˅vā ˅suṣūdatha ˅kṣārayatha prerayatha satkarmasu ˅saḥ ṛṣī rājā vā ˅na ˅jīyate |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro'gre bādhamva vi mṛdho vi durgrahā ’ ( ādha. śrau. 2. 13 ) iti |
niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro'ryamaṇo na marutaḥ kavandhinaḥ |
pinyantyutsaṃ yadināso asvaranyundanti pṛthivīṃ madhvo andhasā ||
niyutvantaḥ | grāma'jitaḥ | yathā | naraḥ | aryamaṇaḥ | na | marutaḥ | kavandhinaḥ | pinyanti | utsam | yat | ināsaḥ | asvaran | vi | undanti | pṛthivīm | madhvaḥ | andhasā || 8 ||
˅grāmajitaḥ saṃghātatmakasya padārthasya viśleṣayitāraḥ ˅naraḥ narākārā netāro vā |
nitarāṃ yavana- vanto'śvavanto grāmajito grāmasya jenāro nara iva manuṣyā iva tathā bhavanti |
˅yat yadā ˅ināsaḥ īśvarāḥ ˅utsaṃ kṛpādinimnapradeśaṃ meghaṃ vā ˅pinyanti pyāyayantyudakena |
yadā ˅asvaran śabdayanti yadā ˅dyundanti ˅pṛthivīṃ ˅madhvaḥ madhurasyodakasya ˅andhasā sāreṇa3 tadaivaṃ bhavati |
yadāsvaran tadā pinyantyusamināsaḥ tadāndhasaḥ pṛthivīṃ vyundantīti |

pravata̭vatīyaṃ pṛ̭thi॒vī ma॒rudbhya̭ḥ pravata̭vatī caurbhavati praya॒dbhya̭ḥ | pravata̭vatī | pṛ॒thvī | a॒ntari̭kṣyāḥ | pravata̭vantaḥ | pa॒rvatā̭ḥ jīradā̭navaḥ || 9 || pravata̭vatī | i॒yam | pṛ॒thi॒vī | ma॒rut'bhya̭ḥ | pravata̭vatī | cauḥ | bha॒vati | praya॒t'bhya̭ḥ | pravata̭vatī | pṛ॒thvī | a॒ntari̭kṣyāḥ | pravata̭vantaḥ | pa॒rvatā̭ḥ | jīra'dā̭navaḥ || 9 ||
pravantaḥ prakarṣavanto vistīrṇāḥ pradeśā yasyāṃ sā pravatavatī |
tathā ^antarikṣyāḥ antarikṣe bhavāḥ ^padhyāḥ ^manugato'pi ^pravatavatīḥ pravattvasya marudbhyo bhavanti |

yanma̭rutaḥ sa॒bhara̭saḥ sva॒rnaḥ sūrya̭ u॒ditḙ ma॒rdathā̭ di॒vo na̭ḥ | na vo'śvā̭ḥ śrathayantā॒ha si̭srataḥ sa॒dyo a॒syādhva̭naḥ pā॒rama̭śrutha || 10 || yat | ma॒rutaḥ | sa॒'bhara̭saḥ | svaḥ'na̭raḥ | sūrya̭ | u॒t'i̭te | ma॒rdatha̭ | di॒vaḥ | naḥ | na | vaḥ | aśvā̭ḥ | śra॒tha॒ya॒ntā॒ha | si॒srata̭ḥ | sa॒dyaḥ | a॒sya | a॒dhvana̭ḥ | pā॒ram | a॒śrutha || 10 ||
he ^marutaḥ ^sabharasaḥ sahabalāḥ ^svarnaḥ sarvasya netāro yūyaṃ ^yat yadā ^sūrye ^udite madhyāhne ^madatha somena he ^divaḥ dyulokasya ^naraḥ netāraḥ |
yadā somena madatha tadā tvadīyā aśvā na śithilā bhavanti |

aṃsḙṣu va ṛ॒ṣaya̭ḥ patsu khā॒dayo̭ va॒kṣaḥsṷ ru॒kmā ma̭ruto ra॒the śu॒bhaḥ | agni̭bhrājaso vi॒dyuto॒ garbha̭styoḥ śi॒prāḥ śīrṣa̭su vi॒tatā॒ hira̭ṇyayīḥ || 11 || aṃsḙṣu | vaḥ | ṛ॒ṣaya̭ḥ | pat'su | khā॒daya̭ḥ | va॒kṣaḥ'su | ru॒kmāḥ | ma॒rutaḥ | ra॒the | śu॒bhaḥ | agni̭'bhrājasaḥ | vi॒dyuta̭ḥ | ga॒rbha'styoḥ | śi॒prāḥ | śīrṣa̭'su | vi॒tatā̭ḥ | hi॒ra॒ṇyayīḥ || 11 ||

yūyaṃ rayiṃ marutaḥ spārhavīraṃ yūyamṛṣimavatha sāmavipram | yūyamarvantaṃ bharatāya vājaṃ yūyaṃ dhattha rājānaṃ śruṣmantam || 14 || yūyam | rayim | marutaḥ | spārha'vīram | yūyam | ṛṣima | avatha | sāma'vipram | yūyam | arvantam | bharatāya | vājam | yūyam | dhattha | rājānam | śruṣma'mantam || 14 ||
ha marutaḥ yūyaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ spārhavīraṃ spṛhaṇīyavīraiḥ putrabhṛtyādibhirupetaṃ dhātha dhattha |
ha marutaḥ yūyaṃ sāmavipraṃ sāmnāṃ trividhaṃ pragāyitāraṃ yadvā māmasahitā viprā yasya tādṛśam ṛṣimavatha rakṣatha |
ha yūyam arvantam aśvaṃ vājam annaṃ ca bharatāya devān bibhrate jyāvāśvāya dhattha |
ha marutaḥ yūyaṃ rājānaṃ dīptaṃ svāminaṃ vā śruṣmantaṃ sukhavantam |

tadvau yāmi draviṇaṃ sacaūtayo yenā svaḥrṇa tatanām nṛbhi | idaṃ su meṃ maruto haryatā vaco yasya tarema taramā śata himāḥ || 15 || tat | vaḥ | yāmi | draviṇam | sacaḥ'ūtayaḥ | yena | svaḥ | na | tatanām | nṛn | abhi | idam | su | me | marutaḥ | haryata | vacaḥ | yasya | tarema | tarasā | śatam | himāḥ || 15 ||
sadyogamanā vā vaḥ yuṣmān tat draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ yāmi yācāmahe |
yena dhanena nṛn asmatputrabhṛtyādīn abhi tatanām svarṇe āditya iva raśmīn |
he marutaḥ me mama svabhūtam idam idānīṃ kriyamāṇaṃ vacaḥ stotraṃ su suṣṭhu haryata kāmayadhvam |
yasya stotravacasaḥ tarasā balena śata śatasaṃkhyākān himāḥ hemantān tarema śatavatsaraṃ jīvemetyarthaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘prayajyava imaṃ stomamityāgnimārutam’ ( ādha. śrau. 7. 7 ) iti ||

prayajyavo maruto ārjahaṣṭayo bṛhadvayo dadhire rukmavakṣasaḥ | īyante aśvaiḥ suyamaibhirāśubhiḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata || 1 || pra'yajyavaḥ | marutaḥ | ārjaha'ṛṣṭayaḥ | bṛhat | vayaḥ | dadhire | rukma'vakṣasaḥ | īyante | aśvaiḥ | suyamaibhiḥ | āśu'bhiḥ | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 1 ||
ᵛprayajavaḥ prakarṣeṇa yaṣṭāraḥ ᵛājahvayaḥ dīsāyudhāḥ ᵛmarutaḥ ᵛbṛhat prabhūtaṃ ᵛvayaḥ yauvanalakṣaṇaṃ prabhūtamnaṃ vā ᵛdadhire dhārayanti |
te marutaḥ ᵛsuyamebhiḥ sukhena niyamituṃ śakyaiḥ ᵛāśubhiḥ śīghragaiḥ ᵛaśvaḥ ᵛīyante prāpyante |
udakamabhilakṣya ᵛyātāṃ gacchatāṃ mahatāṃ ᵛrathāḥ api ᵛanu ᵛavṛtsata anuvartante ||
svayaṃ dadhidhve tarvirṣī yathā vid bṛhanmahānta urviyā vi rājatha |
utāntarikṣaṃ mamire vyojasā śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
svayam | dadhidhve | tarvirṣīm | yathā | vid | bṛhat | mahāntaḥ | urviyā | vi | rājatha | uta | antarikṣam | mamire | vi | ojasā | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 2 ||
he maruto yūyaṃ ᵛsvayam asahāyyenaiva ᵛdadhidhve dhārayadhve kurudhva ityarthaḥ |
haṃ ᵛmahāntaḥ yūyam ᵛurviyā uravaḥ santaḥ ᵛvi ᵛrājatha |
ᵛuta api ca ᵛantarikṣam ᵛojasā balena ᵛvi ᵛmamire vyāpnutha |
sākaṃ jātāḥ subhvaḥ sākaṃmukṣitāḥ śriye cidā prataraṃ vāvṛdhurnaraḥ |
virokiṇaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
sākam | jātāḥ | su'bhvaḥ | sākam | ukṣitāḥ | śriye | cit | ā | pra'taram | vavṛdhuḥ | naraḥ | vi'rokiṇaḥ | sūryasya'iva | raśmayaḥ | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 3 ||
ᵛsākaṃ sahaiva ᵛjātāḥ utpannāḥ ᵛsubhvaḥ suṣṭhu bhavantaḥ |
tathaiva ᵛsākaṃ sahaiva ᵛukṣitāḥ sektāro varṣakāḥ ᵛśriye ᵛcit śobhāyā eva ᵛprataraṃ prakṛṣṭataram ᵛā sarvataḥ ᵛvavṛdhuḥ avadhayan |
ᵛnaraḥ karmaṇāṃ netāraḥ ᵛvirokiṇaḥ virocamānāḥ ᵛsūryasyeva ᵛraśmayaḥ sūryaśmaya iva |
ābhuṣeṇyai vo maruto mahitvanaṃ didṛkṣeṇyaṃ sūryasyeva lakṣaṇam |
uto asā~ amṛtatve dadhātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
ā'bhuṣeṇyam | vaḥ | marutaḥ | mahitvanam | didṛkṣeṇyam | sūryasya'iva | lakṣaṇam | uto iti | asmān | amṛta'tve | dadhātana | śu . m | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 4 ||
he ᵛmarutaḥ ᵛvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ᵛmahitvanaṃ mahattvam ᵛābhuṣeṇyaṃ stutyam |
kiṃca ᵛsūryasyeva ᵛlakṣaṇaṃ rūpamiva ᵛdidṛkṣeṇyaṃ darśanīyam |
ᵛuto api ca ᵛasmān ᵛamṛtatve mokṣe svarga ityarthaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—' udīrathayā marutaḥ samudrataḥ pra vo marutastaviṣā udanvataḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 13 ) iti ||
udīrathayā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ |
na vo dastrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhe yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
ut | īrathaya | marutaḥ | samudrataḥ | yūyam | vṛṣṭim | varṣayatha | purīṣiṇaḥ | na | vaḥ | dastrāḥ | upa | dasyanti | dhenavaḥ | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata ||5||
he marutaḥ ' yūyaṃ ' samudrataḥ samudravaṇādhanādantarikṣāt ' udīrathaya prerayatha ' vṛṣṭim |
he ' dastrāḥ darśanīyāḥ śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitārā vā ' vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ' dhenavaḥ prīṇayitāro meghāḥ na ' upa ' dasyanti na śuṣyanti ||
viśvā itspṛdho maruto vyasyatha śubhe yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
yat | aśvān | dhuḥ'su | pṛṣatīḥ | ayugdhvam | hiraṇyayān | prati | atkān | amṛgdhvam | viśvāḥ | it | spṛdhaḥ | marutaḥ | vi | asyatha | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 6 ||
he maruto yūyaṃ ' yat yadā ' aśvān ' dhurṣu rathasambandhinīṣu ' ayugdhvaṃ yojitavantaḥ stha |
' hiraṇyayān hiraṇyavarṇān ' atkān kavacān ' prati ' amṛgdhvaṃ pratyamuñcata |
evaṃ kṛtvā viśvā ' it ' spṛdhaḥ sarvānapi saṃgrāmān he ' marutaḥ ' vyasyatha vikṣipatha |
na parvatā na nadyo varanta vo yatrācidhvaṃ maruto gacchatheḍu tat |
uta dyāvāpṛthivī yāthanā pari śubhe yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
na | parvatāḥ | na | nadyaḥ | varanta | vaḥ | yatra | acidhvam | marutaḥ | gacchatha | it | ū~ iti | tat | uta | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | yāthana | pari | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata ||7||
he marutaḥ vaḥ yuṣmān parvatāḥ śiloccayāḥ na varanta na vārayantu tathā nadyaḥ ca na vārayantu |
kiṃtu yatra yasmin yajñādisthāne acidhvaṃ jānītha saṃkalpayatha tat sthānaṃ gacchathedu gacchathaiva |
uta api ca dyāvāpṛthivī ca pari paritaḥ yāthana yātha vṛṣṭyarthamiti ||
yatpuṇyaṃ maruto yacca nūtanaṃ yadudyatai vasavo yacca śasyate |
viśvasya tasya bhavathā narvedasaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
yat | puṇyam | marutaḥ | yat | ca | nūtanam | yat | udyatai | vasavaḥ | yat | ca | śasyate | viśvasya | tasya | bhavatha | narvedasaḥ | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 8 ||
he marutaḥ yūyaṃ yat pūvyaṃ pūrvatanaṃ pūrvamanuṣṭata yata karmāsmi tadityarthaḥ |
yat ca udyate ūrdhvaṃ prāpyate stūyate ityarthaḥ |
he vasavaḥ vāsakāḥ yacca śasyate śaṃsanaṃ kriyate tasya viśvasya uktasya narvedasaḥ jānantaḥ bhavatha ||
mūḻataṃ no maruto mā vadhiṣṭanāsmabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yantana |
adhi stotrasya sruvasya gātanu śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata ||
mūḻata | naḥ | marutaḥ | mā | vadhiṣṭana | asmabhyam | śarma | bahulam | vi | yantana | adhi | stotrasya | sruvasya | gātanu | śubham | yātām | anu | rathāḥ | avṛtsata || 9 ||
he marutaḥ naḥ asmān mūḻata subhayata |
kiṃtu asmabhyaṃ śarma sukhaṃ bahulam atyadhikaṃ vi yantana kuruta |
kiṃca stotrasya stotraṃ sravasya sravam abhi gātana adhigacchata |
yūyasmānayata vasyo acchā niraihatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ |
juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
yūyam | asmān | nayata | vasyaḥ | acchā | niḥ | ahatibhyaḥ | marutaḥ | gṛṇānāḥ | juṣadhvam | naḥ | havyadātim | yajatrāḥ | vayam | syāma | patayaḥ | rayīṇām || 10 ||
2. ga-ca-jha-ṇa-bha-he vasavaḥ nivāsayitāraḥ yataḥ, ra-he vasavaḥ vāsa- yitāraḥ yat |
he marutaḥ 'yūyamasmān 'vasyaḥ vasīyo dhanaṃ svargādilakṣaṇaṃ sthānaṃ vā 'accha abhilakṣya 'nayata prāpayata |
'jupadhvaṃ sevadhvaṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'havyadātiṃ havirdānavantaṃ yajñaṃ he 'yajatrāḥ yaṣṭavyā yūyam |
'agne śardhantam ' iti navacaṃ dvādaśa sūktaṃ śyāvāśvasyārṣaṃ mārutam |
' agne nava bārhataṃ tṛtīyāsaptamyau satobṛhatyau ' ityanukramaṇikā ||

agne śardhantaṃ gaṇaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ rukmebhirañjibhiḥ | viśoṃ adya marutāmarva hvaye divaścidrocanādadhi || 1 || agne | śardhantam | ā | gaṇam | pṛṣṭam | rukmebhiḥ | añjibhiḥ | viśaḥ | adya | marutām | arva | hvaye | divaḥ | cit | rocanāt | adhi || 1 ||
he 'agne 'śardhantaṃ śatrūnabhibhavantaṃ yajñāyosasahamānaṃ vā 'gaṇaṃ marutāṃ gaṇam 'ā hvayeti śeṣaḥ |

yathā cinmanyase hṛdā tadinme jagmurāśasaṃḥ | ye te nediṣṭhaṃ harvanānyāgamantānvardha bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ || 2 || yathā | cit | manyase | hṛdā | tat | it | me | jagmuḥ | ā'śasaḥ | ye | te | nediṣṭham | harvanāni | ā'gaman | tān | vardha | bhīma'saṃdṛśaḥ || 2 ||
'tadita tathaiva 'me madarthaṃ 'jagmuḥ gacchantu 'āśasaḥ āśaṃsitāra icchantaḥ śatrūn hiṃsanto vā |

anantaraṃ 'ye marutaḥ 'nediṣṭham atyantāntikaṃ saṃvidhāveva 'te tava 'havanāni āhvānāni śrutvā 'āgaman āgacchanti 'tān 'bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ kālavilambāsahanane bhayaṃkaradarśanān 'vardha vardhaya haviṣvāpaṇena ||
3. kha- ca-jha-ṇa-na-bha-ra- 'cit pūraṇaḥ ' nāsti; śa-viditi pūraṇaḥ |

mīḻahuṣmatīva pṛthivī parā̭hatā mada̭ntyetya॒smatā | ṛkṣo na vo marutaḥ śimvīvā~ amau dudhro gauriva bhīmayuḥ || 3 || mīḻahuṣmatī'iva | pṛthivī | parā̭'hatā | mada̭ntī | eti | a॒smāt | ā | ṛkṣaḥ | na | vaḥ | marutaḥ | śimvī'vān | amaḥ | dudhraḥ | gauḥ'iva | bhīma'yuḥ || 3 ||
vmīḻahuṣmatī prabalasvāmikā vparāhatā anyairabhibhūtā vpṛthivī viva |
evaṃ vmadantī hṛṣyantī marutsenā vammana asmānityarthaḥ |
he vmarutaḥ vvaḥ yuṣmākam vamaḥ balaṃ gaṇaḥ vṛkṣo vna abhiriva vśimīvān karmavān vdudhraḥ durdharaḥ vgauriva vbhīmayuḥ bhīmarvṛṣabhaiḥ yuktaḥ vgauriva |

ni ye riṇantyoja̭sā vṛthā gāvo na dudhṷraiḥ | aśmānaṃ citsvarya̭ parva̭taṃ giri̭ pra cyā̭vayanti yāma̭bhiḥ || 4 || ni | ye | riṇanti | oja̭sā | vṛthā | gāvaḥ | na | duḥ'dhuraiḥ | aśmānam | cit | svarya̭m | parva̭tam | giri̭m | pra | cyā̭vayanti | yāma̭bhiḥ || 4 ||
vye marutaḥ vojasā sviyena balena vni vriṇanti hiṃsanti śatrūn vvṛthā anāyāsena svayaṃcāramātreṇa vgāvo vna vdudhuraḥ duḥkhena hiṃsyā aśvā iva |
te marutaḥ vsvaryaṃ śabdayantam vaśmānaṃ vyāsa vparvataṃ jagatpūrakodakavantam |
‘pavevānparvataḥ parva punaḥ : pṛṇāteḥ prīṇātervā’ (niru. 1. 20 ) iti niruktam |
parvata miti viśeṣyaṃ girimiti viśeṣaṇam nigirasyudakamiti giriḥ |
taṃ vyāmabhiḥ gamaneḥ vpra vcyāvayanti udakanirgamanārtham ||

uttiṣṭha nunameṣāṃ stomaiḥ samukṣitānām | marutāṃ purutamapūrvyaṃ gavāṃ sargamiva haye || 5 || ut | tiṣṭha | nunam | eṣām | stomaiḥ | sam'ukṣitānām | marutām | puru'tamam | apūrvyam | gavām | sargam'iva | haye || 5 ||
vnūnaṃ niścayam veṣāṃ vstomaḥ stotraiḥ vsamukṣitānāṃ vardhitānāṃ vmarutām |
na vidyate pūrvaḥ yebhyastamapūrvyaṃ vsargaṃ saṃghaṃ vgavām udakānāṃ prasiddhānāṃ gavāṃ vā sargaṃ saṃgham viva vhaye āhvaye ||
yuṅgdhvaṃ haruṣī rathe yuṅgdhvaṃ rathe ṣu rohitaḥ |
yuṅgdhvaṃ harī ajirā dhuri voḻhave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voḻhave ||
yuṅgdhvam | hi | aruṣīḥ | rathe | yuṅgdhvam | rathe ṣu | rohitaḥ | yuṅgdhvam | harī iti | ajirā | dhuri | voḻhave | vahiṣṭhā | dhuri | voḻhave || 6 ||
ha maruto yūyaṃ rathe yuṣmadīye sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇabhūte aruṣāḥ ārocamānā vaḍavāḥ yuṅgdhvaṃ yojayadhvam |
tathā rathe ṣu yuṣmadīyeṣu rohitaḥ rohitavarṇāḥ yuṅgdhvam |
harī aśvau ajirā ajirāśugamanau dhuri voḻhave vahanāya yuṅgdhvam |
uta sya vājyaruṣastuvisvarniha sma dhāyi darśataḥ |
mā vo yāmeṣu marutaściraṃ karataṃ taṃ rathe ṣu codata ||
uta | sya | vājī | aruṣaḥ | tuvisvarniḥ | iha | sma | dhāyi | darśataḥ | mā | vaḥ | yāmeṣu | marutaḥ | ciram | karata | pra | tam | rathe ṣu | codata || 7 ||
uta api ca sya saḥ vājī vejanavān arupaḥ ārocamānaḥ tuvisvarṇiḥ prabhūtadhvaniraśvaḥ |
iha idānīṃ darśataḥ darśanīyaḥ san dhāyi rathe niyojitaḥ |
he marutaḥ vo yāmeṣu gamaneṣu so'śvaḥ ciraṃ vilambaṃ mā karata mā karotu |
taṃ rathe ṣu rathe yuktamiti śeṣaḥ |
rathaṃ nu mārutaṃ vayaṃ śravasyumā huvāmahe |
ā yasminstathau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marutsu rodasī ||
ratham | nu | mārutam | vayam | śravasyum | ā | huvāmahe | ā | yasmin | tasthau | su'raṇāni | bibhratī | sacā | marutsu | rodasī || 8 ||
vayama ātreyāḥ rathaṃ rahanasvabhāvaṃ mārutaṃ marutāṃ sambandhanaṃ rathaṃ śravasyum anvecchuṃ nu adya ā huvāmaheṃ āhvayāmaḥ |
yasmin rathe suraṇāni jalāni bibhratī dhārayantī rodasī rudrasya patnī marutāṃ mātā |
tatpatnī mādhyamikī devī marutsu sacā sahitā ā tasthau āsthitavatī taṃ rathamāhuve ||
taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ ratheśubhaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumā huve |
yasmintsujātā subhargā mahīyate sacā marutsu mīḻhuṣī ||
tam | vaḥ | śardham | rathe'śubham | tveṣam | panasyum | ā | huve | yasmin | su'jātā | su'bhargā | mahīyate | sacā | marut'su | mīḻhuṣī || 9 ||
he marutaḥ vaḥ śardhaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ balaṃ gaṇaṃ ratheśubhaṃ rathe śobhanaṃ tveṣaṃ dīptaṃ panasyuṃ stutyam ā huve āhvaye |
yasmin śarye sujātā suṣṭhu pravṛddhā subhagā śobhanabhāgyātimahatī mīḻhuṣī |
marutsu sacā saha mahīyate pūjyate taṃ śardhamā huve |
āpastambo'pi rudrapatnīṃ mīḻhuṣīsaṃjñayā vyavajahāra—‘uttarayā dakṣiṇa- syāmīśānamāvāhayati laukikyā vācottarasyāṃ mīḻhuṣīṃ madhye jayantam’ ( āpa. gṛ. 20. 1-3 ) iti ||
tatra ‘ā rudrāsaḥ’ ityaṣṭacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ jyāvāśvasyārṣaṃ māhatam |
ā rudrāsa indravantaḥ sajopaso hiraṇyarathāḥ suvitārya gantana |
iyaṃ vo asmatprati haryate matistṛṣṇaje na diva utsa utdanyave ||
ā | rudrāsaḥ | indra'vantaḥ | sa'joṣasaḥ | hiraṇya'rathāḥ | suvitārya | gantana | iyam | vaḥ | asmat | prati | haryate | matiḥ | tṛṣṇa'jai | na | divaḥ | utsaḥ | uda'nyave || 1 ||

he rudrāsaḥ rudraputrāḥ indravantaḥ indreṇa yuṣmatsvāminā tadvantaḥ sajoṣasaḥ parasparaṃ samāna- prītayaḥ hiraṇyarathāḥ hiraṇyamayarathāḥ mantaḥ suvitārya sugamanāya tatsādhanāya suṣṭhu sarvairgantavyāya yajñāya tadartham ā gantana āgacchata |
iyam asmat asmadīyā matiḥ stutiḥ vaḥ yuṣmān prati haryate kāmayate |
udanyave udakecchave tṛṣṇaje gotamāya divaḥ dyulokasakāśāt utsaḥ udakaniṣyandā yathā yuṣmābhiḥ preritāstadvadasmadarthamapi āgatyābhimaṃtaṃ dadatetyarthaḥ ||

vāśīmanta ṛṣṭimanto manīṣiṇaḥ sudhanvāna iṣunto niṣviṇaḥ | svaśvāḥ stha surathāḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyudhā maruto yātanā śubham || 2 || vāśī'mantaḥ | ṛṣṭi'mantaḥ | manīṣiṇaḥ | su'dhanvānaḥ | iṣu'mantaḥ | niṣviṇaḥ | su'aśvāḥ | stha | su'rathāḥ | pṛśni'mātaraḥ | su'āyudhāḥ | marutaḥ | yātana | śubham ||2||

he marutaḥ yūyaṃ vāśīmantaḥ | vāśīti lakṣaṇamādhanamāyudham | tadvantaḥ stha | ṛṣṭimantaḥ | ṛṣṭīnāṃ churikā | tadvantaḥ stha | evaṃ sarvatra yojyam | manīṣiṇaḥ manasa īśvarā manasvinaḥ | sudhanvānaḥ śobhanadhanuṣkāḥ | iṣumantaḥ bāṇavantaḥ | niṣviṇaḥ niṣvavantaḥ | svaśvāḥ stha śobhanāśvāḥ bhavatha | surathāḥ śobhanarathāḥ | pṛśnimātaraḥ pṛśneḥ putrāḥ | svāyudhāḥ svajñaparathādisakalāyudhopetāḥ | evaṃ mahātmānaḥ mantaḥ | śubhaṃ śobhanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā śubhamudakāya vā rathena yāthana gacchatha ||

dhunutha dyāṃ parvatāndāśuṣe vamu ni vo vanā jihate yārmano bhiyā | kopayatha pṛthivīṃ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhe yadugrāḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam || 3 || dhunutha | dyām | parvatān | dāśuṣe | vasu | ni | vaḥ | vanā | jihate | yārmanaḥ | bhiyā | kopayatha | pṛthivīm | pṛśni'mātaraḥ | śubhe | yat | ugrāḥ | pṛṣatīḥ | ayugdhvam || 3 ||
parvatān meghān dāśuṣe havirdātre yajamānāya vasu dhanāni ca dhunutha prāpayatha |
vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ yāmanaḥ gamanasya niyā bhītyā vanā vanāni vṛkṣādisamūhāḥ ni jihate nitarāṃ kampante |
pṛśnaye vai payasāṃ marutāṃ jātāḥ ( tai. saṃ. 2. 2. 11.4 ) iti hi śrutiḥ |
he marutaḥ pṛthivīṃ kopayatha abhinantyāḥ kṣobhayatha |
he ugrāḥ udbhaṭabalā yūyaṃ yana yadā śubhe udakārthaṃ pṛṣatīḥ yuṣmadīyāḥ aśvāḥ ayugdhvaṃ yojayatha tadā kopayatha pṛthivīm ||

vātatvipo maruto varṣāninirjā yamāīva susaṃdṛśaḥ supeśasaḥ | piśaṅgāśvā aruṇāśvā arepasaḥ pratvakṣaso mahinā dyaurivoravaḥ || 4 || vāta'tviṣaḥ | marutaḥ | varṣa'nirnajaḥ | yamāḥ'iva | su'saṃdṛśaḥ | su'peśasaḥ | piśaṅga'aśvāḥ | aruṇa'aśvāḥ | arepasaḥ | pra'tvakṣasaḥ | mahinā | dyauḥ'iva | uravaḥ ||4||

^yamāiva yugalotpannā iva ^susadṛśa: parasparaṃ balarūpādibhiratyantaṃ sarūpā: ^supeśasa: śobhanarūpā: ^piśaṅgāśvā: piśaṅgavarṇāśvopetāstathā ^aruṇāśvā: ^arepasa: apāpā: ^pravakṣasa: prakṛṣṭa tanukartāro dveṣṭṛṇāṃ ^mahinā mahattvena ^dyauriva antarikṣamiva ^urava: vistīrṇā: |
sujātāsau januṣā rukmavakṣaso divo arkā amṛtaṃ nāma bhejire ||
purudrupsā: | añji'mantaḥ | su'dānava: | tveṣa'saṃdṛśa: | anavabhra'rādhasa: | su'jātāsa: | januṣā | rukma'vakṣasa: | diva: | arkā: | amṛtam | nāma | bhejire ||5||

^purudrupsā: prabhūtoṃdakā: ^añjimantaḥ ābharaṇavantaḥ ^sudānava: śobhanadānā: ^tveṣasaṃdṛśa: dīptarūpā: ^anavabhrarādhasa: anavabhradhanā: ^sujātāsa: śobhanajananā: ^januṣā janmanaivoktarūpā: ^rukmavakṣasa: hāravakṣaskā: ^arkā: pūjyā maruta: ^diva: dyulokādāgatya ^amṛtam amaraṇasādhanaṃ ^nāma udakaṃ namanahetukamuktarūpaṃ havirvā ^bhejire labdhavantaḥ ||
ṛṣṭayo vo maruto aṃsayoradhi saha ojo bāhvorbale hitam |
numṇā śīrṣasvāyudhā rathepu vo viśvā va: śrīradhi tanūpu pipiśa ||
ṛṣṭaya: | va: | maruta: | aṃsayo: | adhi | saha: | oja: | bāhvo: | va: | balam | hitam | numṇā | śīrṣa'su | āyudhā | rathepu | va: | viśvā | va: | śrī: | adhi | tanūpu | pipiśe ||6||
rasāsṛṅamāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśukrāṇi dhātava: iti saptadhātūnāṃ sāro'ṣṭamastu ojaso'pi mukhe yo (yā) kāntirbhāti sa ojo balaṃ ca lakṣyate |

gomadaśvāvadrathavatsuvīraṃ candravadrādho maruto dadā naḥ | praśasti naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣīya vo'vaso daivyasya || 7 || gomat | aśvāvat | rathavat | suvīram | candravat | rādhaḥ | marutaḥ | dada | naḥ | pra'śastim | naḥ | kṛṇuta | rudriyāsaḥ | bhakṣīya | vaḥ | avasaḥ | daivyasya || 7 ||
ha marutaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ gomata bahubhirgobhirupetam aśvāvata bahubhiraśvairupetaṃ rathavata rathopetaṃ suvāra suṣṭhu putropetaṃ candravata hiraṇyopetaṃ rādhaḥ annaṃ dada dadata ||
ha rudriyāsaḥ rudraputrā marutaḥ naḥ asmadīyāṃ praśastim samṛddhimītyarthaḥ |
vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ svabhūtam avasaḥ avaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ daivyasya daivyaṃ devāhaṃ bhakṣīya bhajeya ||

haye naro maruto mṛḻatā ntuviṃmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ || 8 || haye | naraḥ | marutaḥ | mṛḻata | naḥ | tuviṃ'maghāsaḥ | amṛtāḥ | ṛtajñāḥ | satya'śrutaḥ | kavayaḥ | yuvānaḥ | bṛhat'girayaḥ | bṛhat | ukṣamāṇāḥ || 8 ||
haye ha naraḥ netāraḥ marutaḥ naḥ asmān mṛḻata sukhayata asmabhyaṃ hitāya vā sukhino bhavata |
ha tuviṃmaghāsaḥ prabhūtadhanāḥ amṛtāḥ amaraṇasvabhāvāḥ ṛtajñāḥ udakasya yajñasya vā jñātāraḥ |
satyaśrutaḥ satyena satyaphalatvena prasiddhāḥ kavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ yuvānaḥ nityataruṇāḥ bṛhadgirayaḥ prabhūtastutayaḥ bṛhata atyadhikam ukṣamāṇāḥ havirbhiḥ sevitāḥ udakaṃ vā mihanto yūyaṃ mṛḻata ||
‘ namu nūnam ’ ityaṣṭacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ śyāvāśvasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mārutam |

tamu nūnaṃ tarviṣīmantameṣāṃ stuṣe guṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām | ya āśraśvā amaṃvṛddhahanta utteśire amṛtasya svarājaṃḥ || 1 || tam | ū~ iti | nūnam | tarviṣī'mantam | eṣām | stuṣe | guṇam | mārutam | navyasīnām | ye | āśu'aśvāḥ | ama̭'vat | vahante | uta | īśire | amṛtasya | sva'rājaḥ || 1 ||
^tamu tameva pūrvaṃ stutameva ^mārutaṃ marutāṃ sambandhinaṃ ^taṃ ^gaṇaṃ ^tavipīmantaṃ dīptimantaṃ ^nūnam atha ^stuṣe |
^ye marutaḥ ^āśvathāḥ śīghragamya- śraupetāḥ ^amavata balavanto yathā bhavanti tathā ^vahante ^gacchanti^2 |
^uta api ca ^īśire īśvarā bhavanti ^amṛtasya udakasya ^svarājaḥ svāyattadīsayaḥ svayameva rājamānāḥ teṣāṃ gaṇaṃ stuṣe ||
tveṣaṃ guṇaṃ tavasaṃ khādihastaṃ dhuniṃvrataṃ māyinaṃ dātivāram |
mayobhuvo ye armitā mahitvā vandasva vipra tuvirādhaso nṛn ||
tveṣam | gaṇam | tavasam | khādi'hastam | dhuni'vratam | māyinam | dāti'vāram | mayaḥ'bhuvaḥ | ye | armitāḥ | mahi'tvā | vandasva | vipra | tuvi'rādhasaḥ | nṛn || 2 ||

^tveṣaṃ dīptaṃ ^gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ ^tavasaṃ balavantaṃ ^khādihastaṃ kaṭakahastaṃ ^dhuniṃvrataṃ kampayitṛ- karmāṇaṃ ^māyinaṃ prajñāvantaṃ ^dātivāraṃ dattadhanaṃ ha ^vipra hotaḥ ^vandasva stuhīti sambandhaḥ |
ā vo yantūdvāhāso adya vṛṣṭiṃ ye viśve maruto junanti |
ayaṃ yo agnirmarutaḥ samiddha etaṃ juṣadhvaṃ kavayo yuvānaḥ ||
ā | vaḥ | yantu | ut'vāhāḥ | apa | vṛṣṭim | ye | viśve | marutaḥ | junanti | ayam | yaḥ | agniḥ | marutaḥ | sam'iddhaḥ | etam | juṣadhvam | kavayaḥ | yuvānaḥ || 3 ||
^ye ^viśve vyāptāḥ ^marutaḥ ^vṛṣṭiṃ ^junanti prerayanti te ^udavāhāḥ udakasya voḍhāro marutaḥ ^adya idānīṃ ^vaḥ yuṣmāna ^ā ^yantu āgacchantu ha ṛtvijyamānāḥ |
^he ^marutaḥ ^vayaḥ^4 pramiddhaḥ ^ayam ^agniḥ ^samiddhaḥ samyak dīpitaḥ ^etam agni ^juṣadhvaṃ sevadhvaṃ he ^kavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ ^yuvānaḥ nityataruṇāḥ sarvatra vyāptā vā ||
yuyaṃ rājānamirya janāya vimvataṣṭaṃ janayatha yajatrāḥ |
yuṣmadaiti muṣṭihā bāhujūto yuṣmatsadśvo marutaḥ suvīraiḥ ||

he marutaḥ| ᵥyūyaṃ ᵥjanāya yajamānāya ᵥrājānaṃ svāminaṃ rājamānaṃ vā ᵥhyaṃ śatrūṇāṃ prerakaṃ cyāvayitāraṃ ᵥviśvatapm | viśvā nāma ṛbhūṇāṃ madhyamaḥ | sa kuśalī | tena nirmitam | atyantarūpavantamityarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ putraṃ ᵥjanayatha utpādayata he ᵥyajatrāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ | he ᵥmarutaḥ ᵥyuṣmat yuṣmattaḥ ᵥṇati gacchati putraḥ | kīdṛśaḥ | ᵥmuṣṭihā | muṣṭihabdā bāhūpalakṣakaḥ | svabhujavalenaiva hantā śatrūṇām | tadavocyate | ᵥbāhūntaḥ | bāhuḥ prerakaḥ śatrūṇāṃ yasya tādṛśaḥ putra ᵥiti | tathā ᵥyuṣmat yuṣmattaḥ ᵥsadṛśaḥ vidyamānāḥ | bahvaḥ ityarthaḥ | ᵥsuvīraḥ śobhanavīryaḥ putra ᵥiti | jāyate ityarthaḥ ||
varuṇapraghāse mārutyā āmikyāyāḥ ‘ arāiva ’ iti yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca-- ‘ arāiveda- caramā ahevame varu ṇa śrudhi ’ ( āśva. śrau. 2. 17 ) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca-- ‘ arāivedacaramā aheva yā vaḥ śarma śaśamānāya santi ’ ( āśva. śrau. 3. 7 ) iti ||
arāivedacaramā aheva prapra jāyante arkavā mahobhiḥ |
pṛśraiḥ putrā upamāmo ramiṣṭhāḥ svaryā matyā marutaḥ saṃ mimiksuḥ ||

evamuktalakṣaṇāḥ ᵥmahābhiḥ tejobhiḥ ᵥprapa ᵥjāyante prakarṣeṇa prādurbhavanti ||

ᵥpṛśraiḥ mādhyamikāyā vāco gaॉrūpāyā antarikṣasya vā putrasthānīyāḥ |

2. kha-ca-ṇa-eva sādṛśyabhāvaḥ ; jha-na-bha-eva sādṛśyabhāvaḥ; śa-baisādṛśya- bhāvaḥ |
he marataḥ yat yadā prāyāsiṣṭa pragacchatha pṛṣatībhiḥ pṛṣatsaṃjñakaiḥ aśvaiḥ vāhanasādhanairaśvaiḥ |

vanāni vṛkṣamūhāḥ riṇante hisyante vegena bhayyante |

he marataḥ ᵥvaḥ yuṣmabhyaṃ ᵥsuvitāya suṣṭhu prāptavyāya ᵥdāvane haviṣpradānāya ᵥspaṭ spaṣṭa hotā ᵥpra prakarṣeṇa ᵥakan krandati stauti |

krandateḥ śabdakarmaṇo labdharthe laṅi tipi rūpam ||

he maruto yūyaṃ vgavāṃ vśrum viva vuttamam vutkṛṣṭamuṣṇīṣapvādikaṃ vśriyese śriye dhārayatheti śeṣaḥ |
sa yathā vrajasaḥ tejamaḥ vvisarjana vcakṣuḥ darśanasādhanaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhatte tadvadrajo vvṛṣṭivisarjane visarjanāya cakṣuḥ sarvasya prakāśakaṃ tejo dhārayatha |
vatyāiva aśvāiva vsubhvaḥ suṣṭhu sarvatra bhavanto vegavantaḥ vcāravaḥ darśanīyāḥ vmthana bhavatha |
te yathā vśriyese jānanti yajñādikaṃ tadvacchriye vcetana he vnaraḥ netāro marutaḥ ||
yu॒gaṃ ha॒ bhūmī̭ ki॒ra॒ṇaṃ na rḙjatha॒ pra ya॒dvara̭dhve su॒vitārya̭ dā॒vanai̭ ||

vna: asmadarthaṃ vdyau: antarikṣaṃ vmimātu nirmimānu vṛdhim | tadanukūlaṃ karotvityartha: | kīdṛśī | vaditi: adīnā | yadvā | dyaurnimātvaditirbhūrmiśra mimātu suvam | kimartham | vvītaye upattaye prajananāya vā | vdānucitrā: vicitraprakāśādidānā: vupasa: vsaṃ vyatanantām | he vṛṣe tvayā vguṇānā: stūyamānā: vmarutaḥ vrudramya | putrā iti śeṣa: | vte vdivyaṃ vkośaṃ meghamudakam vācucyavu: ācyāvayanti || 24 ||
‘īḻe agniṃ mavasam’ ityṛcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ śyāvāśvasyārṣam |
ᵥpūrvādheṃ ya evamakurvan teṣāṃ stomamadhyāmiti pūrvatrānvayaḥ' |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'parvataścinmahi vṛddho bibhāya sṛjanti raśmimojasā ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 13 ) iti |
parvataścinmahi vṛddho bibhāya divaścinmānu rajata svane veḥ |

ᵥdivaścita antarikṣasyāpi ᵥmānu samucchritaḥ ᵥpradeśaḥ ᵥrejata kampate |
ᵥyat yadā ᵥkīḻatha he ᵥmarutaḥ yūyam ᵥṛṣṭimantaḥ āyudhamantaḥ sanmastadā ᵥāpaiva udakānāṃva ᵥmadhyañcaḥ mahājanāḥ ᵥdhavadhve dhāvadhve gacchatha |

te yathā ᵥraivatāmaḥ dhanavantaḥ ᵥhiraṇyaiḥ hiraṇya- mayairābharaṇaviśeṣaiḥ ᵥsvadhābhiḥ udakaiśca ᵥtanvaḥ svīyāni śarīrāṇi ᵥabhi ᵥpiviśre saṃyojayanti alaṃkurvanti tadvadete maruto'pi raivatāmaḥ dhanavantaḥ ᵥhiraṇyaiḥ hiraṇyasthānīyairviśuddhasyairābharaṇaiḥ svadhābhiśca tanvaḥ svīyāni śarīrāṇi pipiśre |
ᵥśriye śobhāyai ᵥśreyāṃsaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ ᵥtavasaḥ balavanto marutaḥ ᵥratheṣu ᵥsatrā satyaṃ saha vā ᵥtanūpu ᵥmahāṃsi ᵥcakrire kṛtavantaḥ |
ajyeṣṭhāso akaniṣṭhāsa ete saṃ bhrātaro vāvṛdhuḥ saubhagāya |
yuvāṃ pitā khapā rudra eṣāṃ sudaghā pṛśniḥ sudinā marudbhyaḥ ||

yuvā nitya- taruṇaḥ svapāḥ śobhanakarmā eṣāṃ marutāṃ rudraḥ pitā sudughā suṣṭhu dogdhrī pṛśniḥ godevatā mātṛbhūtā marudbhyaḥ marudarthaṃ sudinā śobhanadināni |
yaduttame maruto madhyame vā yadvāvame subhagāso divi ṣṭha |
ato no rudrā uta vā nṛsyāgre vittāddhaviṣā yadyajāma ||

trayo vā ime trivṛto lokāstatro divaḥ pṛthivī ityādiśruteryulāṃkamya traividhyam |
ataḥ asmāt sthānatrayāta naḥ asmadarthaṃ he rudrāḥ āgaccha- teti śeṣaḥ |

agniśca yanmarutāṃ viśvavedaso divo vahdhu uttarāta adhi snubhiḥ |
te maṃdasānā dhunayo riṣādaso vāmaṃ dhatta yajamānāya sunvate ||

anukramaṇikā— ‘ ke dvekonā gāyatraṃ śyāvāśvo'tra vaidadaśvī tarantapurumīḻhau dābhyaṃ ’ rathavīti marutaśca dāntuṣṭaḥ praśaśaṃsa tudadhvā ca taranta- mahiṣīṃ śaśīyasīṃ ’ pañcamyanuṣṭup navamī satānuṣṭubhī ’ iti |
‘ manasā ’ ityādīnāṃ catasṛṇāṃ śaśīyasīṃ nāma tarantasya rājño bhāryā devatā |
‘ uta meḍarapata ’ ityasyā vaidadaśvaḥ purumīḻho devatā |
‘ yo me dhenām ’ ityasyā vaidadaśvastaranto rājā devatā |
‘ etaṃ me ’ ityasya tracasya dābhyo rathavītirnāma rājā devatā |
āśvijyāya vṛto yajñe vinate hautra āsthitaḥ |
yathāce svakumārāya śyāvāśvāya ca tāṃ sutām |
iti pṛṣṭā punaḥ prāha kathamasmai pradāsyasi |
itaḥ pūrvaṃ sutā dattā nāmīdanupaye kvacit ||

iyaṃ purumīḻahastutiḥ | vaidadaśviḥ purumīḻaha'api | yā | me mahaṃ dhenunāṃ jñānaṃ yathā yena prakāreṇa dadat dattavān | tathā maṃhanā maṃhanīyāni dhanānyapi dadata taranta'iva | sa yathā dhenuśataṃ bahuvidhaṃ dhanaṃ ca dattavān tadvaidadadaśviḥ purumīḻaha'api dadata | na mnuve iti śeṣaḥ || || 27 ||
ya ī vahanta āśubhiḥ pibanto madiṃra madhu |
ye | īm | vahante | āśubhiḥ | pibantaḥ | madiṃram | madhu | atra | śravāṃsi | dadhire ||11||
idānīṃ maruta evaita iti niścitya janaprasiddhaiḥ māhātmyaiḥ stauti |

te marutaḥ atra asmin deśe śravāṃsi stutijanitāni yaśāṃsi dadhire dhārayanti ||
yeṣām | śriyā | adhi | rodasī iti | vi'brājante | ratheṣvā | ā | divi | rukmaḥ'iva | upari ||12||
yeṣāṃ marutāṃ śriyā kāntyā rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau adhi adhiṣṭhite bhavata iti śeṣaḥ |
yasmāddete marutaḥ rathepu vibrājante viśeṣeṇa dīpyante |
upari uparibhūte divi dyuloke rukmaḥ rocamānaḥ ādityaḥ iva |
yuvā | sa | mārutaḥ | gaṇaḥ | tveṣa'rathaḥ | anedyaḥ | śubham'yāvā | aprati'skṛtaḥ ||13||

kanyāṃ dattvā kṛtārthaṃ taṃ iyāvāśva'atha vanaṃ gatam |

athavā vāṃ yuvayormadhye sūryasya maṇḍala- mapaśyamiti vyākhyeyaṃ 'maṃtra vā aha: ' (tai. brā. 1. 7. 10. 1) iti śrutermitramyaiva sūryatvādi- vyākhyena |
viśvā: pivantha: svasarasya dhenā anu vāmeka: pavirā vavarva ||
tat | su | vām | mitrāvaruṇā | mahitvam | īrmā | tasthuṣī: | ahaṃbhi: | duduhe | viśvā: | pivantha: | svasarasya | dhenā: | anu | vām | eka: | pavi: | ā | vavarva || 2 ||
'īrmā matatagantā sarvasya prerako vāditya: 'ahabhi: ahobhirvarṣatusaṃbandhibhi: 'tasthuṣī: sthāvarabhūtā apa: 'duduhe dugdhe |
kiṃca 'svamamasya svayaṃ sarturādityasya 'viśvā: sarvā: 'dhenā: lokānāṃ prīṇayitrīrdhutī: 'pivantha: vardhayatha: |
paviriti rathasya nemi: 'pavro rayanemirbhavati ' (niru 5. 5) iti yāskavacanāta |
adhārayataṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ mitrarājānā varuṇā mahobhi: |
vardhayataṃoṣadhī: pivantaṃ gā ava vṛṣṭiṃ sṛjataṃ jīradānū ||
adhārayatam | pṛthivīm | uta | dyām | mitrarājānā | varuṇā | maha:'bhi: | vardhayatam | oṣadhī: | pivantam | gā: | ava | vṛṣṭim | sṛjatam | jīradān iti jīradānū || 3 ||
mitrabhūtā: stotāro rājāna: svāmina īśvarā bhavanti yayo: sakā- śāt 'tau mitrarājānau |
varuṇetyasya tu 'āmantritaṃ pūrvamavidyamānavata 'iti pūrvasyāvidyamānavattvenasyaiva pādādivādanighātatvaṃ yuktam |
'āmantritaṃ samānādhikaraṇe sāmānyavacanam 'iti varuṇetyasyāmantritasamānā- dhikaraṇatvādasya ca sāmānyavacanatvādavidyamānavattvābhāvena pādādivābhāvāduttarasya nighātatvaṃ yuktam |

ā vāmaśvāsaḥ suyujā vahantu yataraśmaya upa yantarvāk | ghṛtasya nirṇiganu vartate vāmupa sindhavaḥ pradivi kṣaranti || 4 || ā | vām | aśvāsaḥ | su'yujaḥ | vahantu | yataḥ'raśmayaḥ | upa | yantu | arvāk | ghṛtasya | niḥ'nika | anu | vartate | vām | upa | sindhavaḥ | pra'divi | kṣaranti || 4 || he mitrāvaruṇau vvāṃ yuvām vaśvāsaḥ aśvāḥ vsuyujaḥ suṣṭhu rathe yuktāḥ santaḥ vā vvahantu | vyataraśmayaḥ sārathiniyatapragrahahaste varvāk vupa vyantu | vghṛtasya udakasya vnirṇiga rūpaṃ vvām vanu vvartate anugacchati | kiṃca vpradivi purāṇāmetat | purāṇāḥ vsindhavaḥ vupa vkṣaranti upagacchanti yuvayoranugrahāt ||

anu śrutāmatiṃ vardhurvau bahiriva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā | narmasvantā ghṛtadakṣādhi garte mitrāsāthe varuṇoḻosvantaḥ || 5 || anu | śrutām | amatim | vardhat | urvīm | barhiḥ'iva | yajuṣā | rakṣamāṇā | narmasvantā | ghṛta'dakṣā | adhi | garte | mitra | āsāthe | iti | varuṇa | iḻāsu | antariti ||5|| vśrutāṃ viśvatām vamatim | rūpanāmaitat | śarīradīptimityarthaḥ | tām vanu vvardhata anuvardha- yantau | vbarhiḥ yajñaḥ | saḥ viva sa yathā vyajuṣā mantreṇa rakṣyate tadvat vurvī vrakṣamāṇā pālayantau vnamasvantā annavantau he vghṛtadakṣā āttabalau he vmitra he vvaruṇa he mitrāvaruṇau yuvāmuktalakṣaṇau mantau viḻāsu yāgabhūmiṣu vantaḥ madhye vgarte vadhi rathe vāsāthe upaviśathaḥ | ' ratho'pi garte ucyate ' ( niru. 3. 5 ) iti yāskaḥ | ' ā rohatho varuṇa mitra gartam ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 62. 8 ) iti || || 30 ||

arkavihastā sukṛtai paraspā yaṃ trāsāthe varuṇoḻosvantaḥ | rājānā kṣatramahaṇīyamānā sahasrasthūṇaṃ bibhrathaḥ saha dvau || 6 || arkavi'hastā | su'kṛtai | puraḥ'pā | yam | trāsāthe | iti | varuṇa | iḻāsu | antariti | rājānā | kṣatram | ahaṇīyamānā | sahasra'sthūṇam | bibhrathaḥ | saha | dvau || 6 || varkavihastā akupaṇahastau | dānaśūrāvityarthaḥ | kasmai | vsukṛte śobhanastutikartre vparaspā parastāt pātārau rakṣitārau he vvaruṇa mitrāvaruṇau yuvāṃ vyaṃ yajamānam viḻāsu yāgabhūmiṣu vantaḥ madhye vtrāsāthe rakṣathaḥ tasmai sukṛte varkavihastā vparaspā ca bhavata iti saṃbandhaḥ | kiṃca yuvāṃ vrājānā rājamānau vahaṇīyamānā akudhyantau vdvau parasparaṃ vsaha sāhāyyena vkṣatraṃ dhanaṃ vsahasrasthūṇam ane-
kāvastambhakastambhopetaṃ saughādirūpaṃ gṛhaṃ ca vibhrathaḥ dhārayathaḥ sukṛte yajamānāya |
kṣatraṃ balama- parimitābhiḥ sthūṇābhirupetaṃ rathaṃ cāgamanārthaṃ saha dhārayathaḥ ||
hiraṇyanirṇayau asya sthūṇā vi ajate divyaśvārjanīva |
bhadre kṣetre nirmitā tilvile vā sunemaṃ madhvo adhigatyasya ||
hiraṇya'nirṇik | arthaḥ | asya | sthūṇā | vi | ajate | divi | aśvārjanī'iva |
bhadre | kṣetre | ni'rmitā | tilvile | vā | sunemaṃ | madhvaḥ | adhi'gatyasya || 7 ||

anayāṃ rathaḥ vhiraṇyanirṇiku hiraṇyarūpaḥ | vnirṇāgiti rūpanāma | vasya rathasya vsthūṇā kīlakā- dayaḥ vayaḥ | vhiraṇyanāmaitana | vayovikārā ityarthaḥ | vayomayā vā | tādṛśo rathaḥ vdivi antarikṣe vvi vajate | kimiva | vaśvārjanīva | vaśvā jñāpanaśīlā meghāḥ | vtānajati gacchatī
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yadvihiṣṭaṃ nātividhe sudānu hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre ’ ( ādha. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||
yadvihiṣṭaṃ nātividhe sudānu achidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā |
tenaṃ no mitrāvaruṇāvaviṣṭaṃ sipāsanto jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma ||
yat | baṃhiṣṭham | na | ati'vidhe | sudānu iti su'dānu | achidram | śarma | bhuvanasya | gopā | tena | naḥ | mitrāvaruṇau | aviṣṭam | sipāsantaḥ | jigīvāṃsaḥ | syāma || 9 ||
he sudānu śobhanadānau he bhuvanasya gopā yuvāṃ baṃhiṣṭhaṃ bahutamaṃ yat achidram anavacchinnaṃ śarma sukhaṃ gṛhaṃ vā nātividhe ativeddhumaśakyaṃ śarmīti śarmaviśeṣaṇam ||
‘ vyadha tāḍane ’ ityasmādyupapade kṛthārthe kena saṃpramāraṇaṃ ca ||
tādṛśaṃ śarma dhārayathaḥ 1 tena śarmaṇā naḥ asmān aviṣṭaṃ
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |

ṛtasya gopāvadhi tiṣṭhatho rathaṃ satyadharmāṇā parame vyomani | yamatra mitrāvaruṇāvatho yuvaṃ tasmai vṛṣṭirmadhumatpinyate divaḥ || 1 || ṛtasya | gopā | adhi | tiṣṭhathaḥ | ratham | satyadharmāṇā | parame | vi'omana | yam | atra | mitrāvaruṇā | avathaḥ | yuvam | tasmai | vṛṣṭiḥ | madhu'mat | pinyate | divaḥ ||1||
he ‘ṛtasya udakasya’ gopā rakṣitārau satyadharmāṇā satyadharmāṇau yuvāṃ ratham adhi tiṣṭhathaḥ |
he mitrāvaruṇau yuvāṃ yuvām atra asmin yajñe yaṃ yajamānam avathaḥ rakṣathaḥ tasmai yajamānāya vṛṣṭiḥ parjanyaḥ madhumat udakaṃ divaḥ dyulokān pinyate siñcati vardhayati ||

samrājāvasya bhuvanasya rājatho mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svardṛśā | vṛṣṭiṃ vāṃ rādhāṃ amṛtatvamīmahe dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti tanvaḥ || 2 || sam'rājau | asya | bhuvanasya | rājathaḥ | mitrāvaruṇā | vidathe | svaḥ'dṛśā | vṛṣṭim | vām | rādhaḥ | amṛtatvam | īmahe | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | vi | caranti | tanvaḥ ||2||
he mitrāvaruṇā mitrāvaruṇau samrājau samyak rājamānau yuvām asya bhuvanasya rājathaḥ īśāthe |
svardṛśā svargasya draṣṭārau yuvāṃ vidathe asamayajñe samrājāviti sambandhaḥ |
vāṃ yuvāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ rādhaḥ dhanaṃ vṛṣṭyākhyaṃ dhanam amṛtatvaṃ svargaṃ ca īmahe prārthayāmahe |
yuvayoḥ tanvaḥ visṛtā raśmayaḥ dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti vividhaṃ prāpnuvanti |
1. kha-jha-bha-udakasya vā; ta-yajñasyodakasya vā; na-udakasya yajñasya vā |
samrājā ugrā vṛṣabhā divaspatī pṛthivyā mitrāvaruṇā vircarṣaṇī |
citrebhirbharai rupa tiṣṭhatho ravaṃ dyāṃ varṣayatho asurasya māyayā ||
samrājau | ugrā | vṛṣabhā | divaḥ | patī iti | pṛthivyāḥ | mitrāvaruṇā | vircarṣaṇī iti vi'carṣaṇī | citrebhiḥ | abhraiḥ | upa | tiṣṭhathaḥ | ravam | dyām | varṣayathaḥ | asurasya | māyayā || 3 ||
'samrājau' samyak rājamānau 'ugrā' udbhaṭabalau 'vṛṣabhā' varṣitārau 'divaḥ' dyulokasya 'patī' svāminau 'pṛthivyāḥ' ca patī 'vircarṣaṇī' sarvasya draṣṭārau mitrāvaruṇau |
evaṃ mahānubhāvau 'citrebhiḥ' cāyanīyaiḥ 'abhraiḥ' meghaiḥ saha 'ravaṃ' stotram 'upa' 'tiṣṭhathaḥ |
paśdhāna 'yāṃ' ca 'varṣayathaḥ 'asurasya udakanirasituḥ parjanyasya 'māyayā prajñayā sāmarthyena ||
māyā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryo jyotiścarati citramāyudham |
tamabhreṇa vṛṣṭyā gūhatho divi parjanya drapsā madhumanta īrate ||
māyā | vām | mitrāvaruṇā | divi | śritā | sūryaḥ | jyotiḥ | carati | citram | āyudham | tam | abhreṇa | vṛṣṭyā | gūhathaḥ | divi | parjanya | drapsāḥ | madhu'mantaḥ | īrate || 4 ||
'sūryaḥ sarvasya prerakaḥ 'jyotiḥ dīyamānaḥ 'citraṃ cāyanīyam 'āyudham utlakṣaṇāyudharūpaḥ 'carati paribhramannantarikṣe |
he 'parjanya deva' mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ vṛṣṭyarthaṃ preśitena tvayā 'madhumantaḥ 'drapsāḥ 'īrate īryante |
rathe yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukhaṃ śūro na mitrāvaruṇā gaviṣṭiṣu |
rajāṃsi citrā vi caranti tanvo divaḥ samrājā paryasā na ukṣatam ||
ratham | yuñjate | marutaḥ | śubhe | su'kham | śūraḥ | na | mitrāvaruṇā | go'iṣṭiṣu | rajāṃsi | citrā | vi | caranti | tanvaḥ | divaḥ | samrājā | paryasā | naḥ | ukṣatam ||5||
he mitrāvaruṇau yuvayoranugrahāt 'marutaḥ 'mahataḥ 'śubhe udakārthaṃ 'sukhaṃ śobhanākṣadvāraṃ 'rathaṃ 'yuñjate aśvairyojayanti |
sa yathā yuddhārthaṃ rathaṃ yunakti tadvat |
eṣaṇeṇu nimitteṣu ᵥcitrā cāyanīyāni ᵥrajāṃsi lokān ᵥtanvyaḥ tatāste marutaḥ ᵥvi ᵥcaranti vividhaṃ caranti |
tasmāt taiḥ mahitau he ᵥsamrājā yuvāṃ ᵥdivaḥ dyulokāna ᵥpayasā udakena ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥukṣataṃ siñcatam ||
vācaṃ su mitrāvaruṇāvirāvartī parjanyaścitrāṃ vadati tviṣīmatīm |
annā vaṃsata marutaḥ su māyā yāṃ varṣayatamaruṇāmarepasam ||
vācam | su | mitrāvaruṇau | irā'vatīm | parjanyaḥ | citrām | vadati | tvirbi'matīm | annā | vasata | marutaḥ | su | māyayā | yām | varṣayatam | aruṇām | arepasam || 6 ||
he ᵥmitrāvaruṇau yuvayoranugrahāt ᵥparjanyaḥ meghaḥ ᵥsu suṣṭhu ᵥirāvatīm annavatīm annasādhikāṃ ᵥcitrāṃ cāyanīyāṃ ᵥtviṣīmatīṃ dīptimatīṃ ᵥvācaṃ garjanaśabdaṃ ᵥvadati |
ᵥmarutaḥ ca ᵥannā abhrāṇi meghāna ᵥsu suṣṭhu ᵥvasata ācchādayanti ᵥmāyayā svaprajñayā |
yuvāṃ ca parjanyena marudbhiḥ saha ᵥaruṇām aruṇavarṇām ᵥarepasam apāpāṃ vṛṣṭyavighātinīṃ ᵥyāṃ ᵥvarṣayatam ||
dharmeṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vratā rakṣethe asurasya māyayā |
ṛtena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājathaḥ sūryamā dhattho divi citryaṃ ratham ||
dharmeṇā | mitrāvaruṇau | vipaḥ'citā | vratā | rakṣethe iti | asurasya | māyayā | ṛtena | viśvam | bhuvanam | vi | rājathaḥ | sūryam | ā | dhatthaḥ | divi | citryam | ratham || 7 ||
he ᵥmitrāvaruṇā ᵥvipaścitā prājñau yuvāṃ ᵥdharmeṇā jagaddhārakeṇa vṛṣṭyādilakṣaṇena karmaṇā ᵥvratā yajñādikarmāṇi ᵥrakṣethe pālayathaḥ |
ᵥasurasya meghānāṃ nirasituḥ parjanyasya ᵥmāyayā prajñayā ca ᵥṛtena udakena yajñena vā nimittena ᵥviśvaṃ ᵥbhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtajātaṃ ᵥvi ᵥrājathaḥ vidāpayathaḥ 2 ityarthaḥ |
ᵥsūryamā sūrya ca ᵥcitryaṃ pūjyaṃ ᵥrathaṃ rahaṇasvabhāvaṃ ᵥdivi dyuloke ᵥdhatthaḥ dhārayatho jagadupakārārtham ||
‘varuṇa vaḥ’ iti saptamaṣṭamaṃ sūktamarcanānam āpaṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
tatkṛtayāhutyā ( tatkṛtayā stutyā-kha-ca-ṇa ) vṛṣṭyutpatteḥ vratā vratena yuvayoḥ karmaṇā |

varuṇaṃ vo riśādasamutrā mitraṃ havāmahe | pariṃ vṛjevaṃ bāhvojaṃnvāṃsā svarvaram || 1 || varuṇam | vaḥ | riśādasam | ṛcā | mitram | havāmahe | pari | vṛjā'iva | bāhvoḥ | jaganvāṃsā | svaḥ'naram || 1 ||
evaṃvidhaṃ varuṇam uktalakṣaṇaṃ mitraṃ ca ṛcā mantreṇa havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ |
vṛjeva goṣṭhārthāva bāhvoḥ balena pari jaganvāṃsā parigacchantau ||
tā bāhavā sucetunā pra yantammasmā arcate | śevaṃ hi jāryaṃ vāṃ viśvāṃsu kṣāmu joguve || 2 || tā | bāhavā | su'cetunā | pra | yantam | asmai | arcata | śevam | hi | jāryam | vām | viśvā
na kevalamahameka eva ganttā kintu sarve'pi tathāgamajñiṣyāha |
tasya 'śarmaṇi sukhe gṛha sthāne vā 'saścire saṃgatāḥ ||
yaddha kṣayai maghonāṃ stotṛṇāṃ ca spudhamai ||
yuvābhyām | mitrāvaruṇā | upamam | dhaiyām | ṛcā | yat | ha | kṣayai | maghonām | stotṛṇām | ca | spudhase || 4 ||
ha 'mitrāvaruṇā 'yuvābhyāṃ dātavyam 'upamam upa samīpe mīyamānaṃ dhanam 'ṛcā stutyā sādhanena 'dhaiyāṃ dhārayāmi |
'yaddha yata khalu yuvābhyāṃ sakāśādāptaṃ dhanaṃ 'maghonāṃ dhanavatāmadātṛṇāṃ 'stotṛṇāṃ 'ca kṣaye gṛhe 'spudhasaṃ spadhanāya bhavati |
dhanikānāṃ stotṛṇāṃ ca dhanādhivyaviṣaye spardhā bhavatātyarthaḥ |
ā nau mitra mudītibhirvaruṇaśca madhastha ā |
sva kṣayai maghonāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca vṛdhase ||
ā | naḥ | mitra | sudītibhiḥ | varuṇaḥ | ca | madhasthe | ā | sve | kṣayai | maghonām | sakhīnām | ca | vṛdhase || 5 ||
ha 'mitra 'vaṃ ca 'varuṇaśca 'sudītibhiḥ sudītisiyuktau yuvāṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'madhasthe sahasthāne yajñe 'ā gacchatam |
'maghonāṃ dhanavatāṃ haviṣmatāṃ 'sakhīnāṃ 'ca yuvayoḥ sakhibhūtānāmasmākaṃ 'kṣaye gṛhe 'sve svakīye 'vṛdhase vardhanāya |
yuvaṃ no yeṣu varuṇa kṣatraṃ bṛhacca bibhṛthaḥ |
uru ṇo vājasātaye kṛtaṃ gaye svastaye ||
yuvam | naḥ | yeṣu | varuṇā | kṣatram | bṛhat | ca | bibhṛthaḥ | uru | naḥ | vājasātaye | kṛtam | rāye | svastaye || 6 ||

ha 'varuṇā mitrāvaruṇau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'kṣatraṃ balaṃ 'bṛhat brahma parigṛhamannaṃ 'ca 'yeṣu stotreṣu nimitteṣu 'bibhṛthaḥ dhārayathaḥ yuvābhyāṃ dhṛtam annaṃ 'ca 'naḥ asmabhyaṃ 'vājasātaye annasya lābhāya yajñāya vā 'rāye dhanāya 'svastaye kṣemāya ca 'uru vistīrṇaṃ 'kṛtaṃ kṛtam ||
sutaṃ somaṃ na hastabhiḥ pṛddhirdhāvataṃ narā bibhratāvarcanānasam ||
ucchantyām | me | yajatā | devakṣetre | ruśat'gavi | sutam | somam | na | hasta'bhiḥ | ā | pṛt'bhiḥ | dhāvatam | narā | bibhratau | arcanānasam || 7 ||
'yajatā' yaṣṭavyau 'ruśadgavi rocamānaraśmau prātaḥsavane 'devakṣetre devānāṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ yasmin yajñe' tadevakṣetram |
'yaśriketa' iti ṣaḍ‌caṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ gatahavyasyātraisyāpaṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
yaśriketa sa sukṛturdevatrā sa bravītu naḥ |
varuṇo yasya darśato mitro vā vanate giraḥ ||
yaḥ | ciketa | saḥ | su'kratuḥ | deva'trā | saḥ | bravītu | naḥ | varuṇaḥ | yasya | darśataḥ | mitraḥ | vā | vanate | giraḥ || 1 ||
'yaḥ stotā 'ciketa jānāti stutiṃ yuvayoḥ 'sa 'sukṛtuḥ sa eva śobhanakarmā 'devatrā deveṣu stotramadhye |
tā | hi | śreṣṭha'varcasā | rājānā | dīrghaśrut'tamā | tā | sat'patī | iti satvatpatī | ṛta'vṛdhā | ṛta'vānā | jane'jane || 2 ||
^vtā ^vhi tau khalu mitrāvaruṇau ^vśreṣṭhavarcasā praśastatejaskau ^vrājānā īśvarau ^vdīrghaśruttamā dūradṛśādāhanaśronṛtamau|
^vtā tau ^vsapatī satāṃ yajamānānāṃ svāminau ^vṛtāvṛdhā yajñasyodakasya vā vardhayitārau ^vjanejane sarveṣu stotreṣu nimitteṣu ^vṛtāvānā gamanavantau ||
tā vāmiyāno'vase pūrvā upa bruve sacā |
svaśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājā~ abhi pra dāvane ||
tā | vām | iyānaḥ | avase | pūrvā | upa | bruve | sacā | su'aśvāsaḥ | su | cetunā | vājān | abhi | pra | dāvane || 3 ||
^vtā tau ^vpūrvā purātanau ^vvāṃ yuvām ^viyānaḥ gacchan ^vavase rakṣaṇāya ^vsacā saha ^vupa ^vbruve upetya staumi |
^vsucetunā śobhanaprajñānau yuvāṃ ^vvājānabhi annānyabhilakṣya ^vpra prakarṣeṇa ^vdāvane dānāya stuma iti śeṣaḥ |
mitraḥ | aṃhoḥ | cit | āt | uru | kṣayāya | gātum | vanate | mitrasya | hi | pra'tūrvataḥ | su'matiḥ | asti | vidhataḥ || 4 ||
^vmitraḥ devaḥ ^vaṃhościt aṃhastato'pi stotuḥ ^vāt anantarameva ^vuru uruve ^vkṣayāya gṛhāya nivāsāya vā ^vgātum upāyaṃ ^vvanate prayacchati |
^vmitrasya ^vhi mitrasya khalu devasya ^vsumatiḥ śobhanabuddhiḥ ^vpratūrvataḥ prakarṣeṇa hiṃsataḥ'pi ^vvidhataḥ paricarataḥ śuśrūpakasya ^vasti hi bhavati khalu ||
vayam | mitrasya | avasi | syāma | saprathaḥ'tame | anehasaḥ | tvā'ūtayaḥ | satrā | varuṇa'śeṣasaḥ || 5 ||
^vvayaṃ yajamānāḥ ^vmitrasya duḥkhanivārakasya devasya ^vsaprathastame sarvataḥ pṛthutame ^vavasi rakṣaṇe vayaṃ ^vsyāma bhavema |

yu॒vaṃ mi̭tre॒maṃ ja॒naṃ ya̭tathu॒ḥ saṃ ca̭ nayatha॒ḥ | mā ma॒dhona̭ḥ pari̭ ruya॒taṃ mo a॒smākamṛ̭ṣī॒ṇāṃ gopī॒the na̭ u॒ruṣya̭tam || 6 || yu॒vam | mi॒traḥ | i॒mam | ja॒nam | ya॒thaḥ | sam | ca̭ | na॒ya॒thaḥ | mā | ma॒dhona̭ḥ | pari̭ | ra॒ya॒tam | mo iti̭ | a॒smāka̭m | ṛ॒ṣī॒ṇām | go'pī॒the | naḥ | u॒ruṣya̭tam || 6 ||

he ᵥmitrā mitrāvaruṇau ᵥyuvaṃ yuvām ᵥimaṃ ᵥjanaṃ stotāraṃ māṃ prati ᵥyatathaḥ gacchathaḥ | āgatya ca ᵥsaṃ ᵥca ᵥnayathaḥ saṃyathaśca | kāmān prāpayathaḥ | yadvā | yathatha ityantarṇītaṇyaryo'yam | ahani yanathaḥ vyāpāreṣu gamayathaḥ | rātrau ca saṃ nayathaḥ | nidhyāpāraṃ kārayathaḥ | ᵥmaghonaḥ havirlakṣaṇāt- vato'smān ᵥmā ᵥpari ᵥrayataṃ mā pariṣjayatam | ᵥmo maiva ᵥṛṣīṇām ᵥasmākaṃ putrānapi pari rayatam | kiṃtu ᵥgopīthe | gauḥ momaram | tasya pānaṃ yasmin sa gopītho yajñaḥ | tasmin ᵥnaḥ ᵥuru- ṣyataṃ rakṣatam || 3 ||
‘ ā cikitāna ’ iti ṣaḍ‌caṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ rātahavyasyārṣam ’ ānuṣṭubhaṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
anvānuka- maṇikā—‘ ā cikitānānuṣṭubhaṃ tu ’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ ā cikitāna sukratū dyamu vo aprahaṇam ’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 11 ) iti ||
ā ci̭ki॒tāna॒ sukra̭tū de॒vau ma̭rta ri॒śāda̭sā |
ā | ci॒ki॒tān | sukra̭tū iti su'kratṷ̄ | de॒vau | ma̭rta | ri॒śāda̭sā | va॒rṷṇāya | ṛ॒ta'pḙśase | dadhīta | praya̭se | ma॒he || 1 ||

he ᵥcikitāna jānan stutiṃ ᵥha ᵥmate manuṣya³ rātahavya tvamiti tasyaiva saṃbodhanam | ᵥsukratū śobhanakarmāṃgau ᵥriśādasā hisakānāṃ hisakau ᵥdevau ᵥā ākārayeti śeṣaḥ | āhvaya ca ᵥṛtapeśase | peśa iti rūpanāma | ṛtamudakam | udakameva ᵥrūpaṃ ᵥyasya tādṛśāya ᵥvaruṇāya ᵥprayase | mavartho lupte | havirlakṣaṇājjavate ᵥmahaṃ mahate pūjyāya ᵥdadhīta dadyāḥ | haviriti śeṣaḥ | dvitīyārthe vā caturthī | mahadvirdadhīta | mahatāṃ'sya lābhāyeti vā yojyam ||
1 kha-ca-jha-ṇa-ta-bha-ra-iyāvākṣadhyārtham | 2 jha-ta-na-ra-stutijña | 3 jha-na-ra-‘ manuṣya ’ nāsti | 4 na-medharūpam | 5 kha-ca-jha-ṇa-ta-bha-ra-śa- ‘ varuṇāya ’ nāsti |

tata̭ṃ pṛ̭thi॒vi bṛ॒hacchra॒va ṛ॒ṣī॒ṇām | ja॒ya॒mānā̭va॒raṃ pṛ̭tha॒ti kṣa॒ranti॒ yāma̭bhiḥ || 5 || tat | ṛ॒tam | pṛ॒thi॒vi | bṛ॒hat | śra॒vaḥ | e॒ṣe | ṛ॒ṣī॒ṇām | ja॒ya॒sānau | a॒ram | pṛ॒th | a॒ti | kṣa॒ranti | yāma̭bhiḥ || 5 ||
he pṛ̭thi॒vi devi tvayi 'tat sarva̭rthyamānatvena prasiddhaṃ 'bṛ॒hat prabhūtam 'ṛ॒tam udakam 'ṛṣīṇāṃ stotṛṇāmasmākaṃ 'śrava̭ṇe annasyaipaṇe sati 'jrayamāṇau gacchantau ||
'chandasyamānaca śuj- bhyām' (u. sū. 2. 243 ) ityasānac jrayaterapi' bhavati' |
'aram alamatyartha 'pṛthu yathā bhavati tathā 'yāmabhiḥ gamanaiḥ 'ati 'kṣaranti asyartha varṣataḥ ||

he devā dyotamānau he ādityā aditaḥ putrau he varuṇa he aryamana arīṇāṃ niyamitaḥ mitra deva yuvāṃ baṭ satyaṃ niṣkṛtam avādhyam itthā ittham idānīṃ vartamānaprakāreṇa yajataṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ bṛhat atipravṛddhaṃ vāpiṣṭhaṃ pravṛddhatamaṃ kṣatraṃ balam āśāthe aśnuvāthe |
ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇa mitra sadyaḥ |
ā | yat | yonim | hiraṇyayam | varuṇa | mitra | sadyaḥ | dhartārāṃ | carṣaṇīnām | yantam | sumram | riṃśādasā || 2 ||

yan yasmāt hiraṇyayaṃ hitaramaṇāya yāni yajñabhāmi he varuṇa he mitra ā sadyaḥ āgacchathaḥ tasmān carṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ dhatārāṃ dhārakau ca he riṃśādasā hiṃsakānāṃ kṣatārau yuvām asmabhyaṃ sujñaṃ sumraṃ yantaṃ kurutamityarthaḥ ||
viśve hi viśvavedaso varuṇo mitro aryamā |
vratā padeva maśire pānti martya riṣaḥ ||
viśve | hi | viśvavedasaḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | vratā | padā'iva | saśire | pānti | martyam | ripaḥ || 3 ||
viśvavedasaḥ sarvavidaḥ sarvadhanā vā varuṇo mitro aryamā caite trayaḥ sarve vratā aramadīyāni karmāṇi padeva padāniva sthānanīva maśire mantā bhavanti |
āgamya ca māṃ martyaṃ ripaḥ hiṃsāt pānti rakṣanti ||
te hi satyā ṛtaspṛśaḥ kṛtāvāno janaijane |
te | hi | satyāḥ | ṛtaspṛśaḥ | ṛta'vānaḥ | jane'jane | sunīthāsaḥ | sudānavaḥ | ahoḥ | cit | uru'cakrayaḥ || 4 ||
te hi khalu satyāḥ satyabhūtāḥ satyaphalā vā ṛtaspṛśaḥ udakasparśasya kartāraḥ ṛtāvānaḥ yajñavantaḥ janeṣu sarveṣu yajamāneṣu munīthām sunayanāḥ sudānavaḥ sudānāḥ|
ko nu vāṃ mitrāstaṃto varṷṇo vā ta॒nūnā̭m |
kaḥ | nu | vām | mitra | astaṃtaḥ | varuṇaḥ | vā | tanūnām | tat | su | vām | ā | īṣate | matiḥ | atri'bhyaḥ | ā | īṣate | matiḥ || 5 ||
haṃ mitra vāṃ yuvayormadhye yaṃ ca varuṇo vā ko nu astaṃtaḥ|
atra mitraśabdena mitrasyaikasyaiva saṃbodhanam varuṇāsvantaḥ ( ṛ. saṃ. 5. 62. 6 ) ityevevātra dvivacanasūcakasyākārasya anāmnātaḥ|
lokeṣu bahuṣu saṃnihiteṣu ekameva saṃbodhya yuvayoridaṃ yuṣmākamidarmiti prayuñjate ||
tannām alpamartānāmasmākaṃ matiḥ stutiḥ vāṃ yuvāṃ suṣṭhu eṣate abhigacchati |
pra vo mitrāya ' śāṃta pañcarca dvādaśaṃ sūktamātreyam yajatasyāpa gāyatraṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
tathā cānukramyate— ' pra vo gāyatram ' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ' pra vo mitrāya pra mitrayorvaruṇayoḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 5. 10 ) iti |
abhiplavapahe pṛṣṭhya- pahe ca stomanimittāvāpārthamidamārdāni dvitīyārvajanāni catvāri muktāni |
tathaiva sūtritaṃ— ' pra vo mitrāyati nṛṇāṃ dvitīyamudareta ' ( āśva. śrau. 9. 5 ) iti ||
pra vo mi॒trāya̭ gā॒yatu॒ varṷṇāya vi॒pā gi॒rā |
pra | vaḥ | mitrāya | gāyatu | varuṇāya | vipā | girā | mahi'kṣatrau | ṛtam | bṛhata || 1 ||
mitrāya varuṇāya ca vipā vyāmayā girā stutyā pra gāyatu stutiṃ kuruta |
haṃ mahikṣatrau prabhūtabalau yuvām ṛtaṃ yajñaṃ bṛhata mahata atipraśastam |
athavā mahata prabhūtam ṛtaṃ stotraṃ śṛṇutabhiti śeṣaḥ ||
samrājā yā ghṛtayaunī mitraśobhā varuṇaśca | devā deveṣu praśastā || 2 || sama'rājā | yā | ghṛtayaunī iti ghṛta'yaunī | mitraḥ | ca | ubhā | varuṇaḥ | ca | devā | deveṣu | pra'śastā || 2 ||
' ubhā ubhau ' samrājā sarvasya svāminau ' ghṛtayaunī udakasyotpādakau ' devā ' dyotamānau ' deveṣu madhye ' praśastā prakarṣeṇa stutyau |
tā naḥ śakta pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya | mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu || 3 || tā | naḥ | śaktam | pārthivasya | mahaḥ | rāyaḥ | divyasya | mahi | vām | kṣatram | deveṣu ||3||
' tā tau ' devau ' naḥ asmadarthaṃ ' pārthivasya pṛthivīsaṃbaddhasya ' divyasya divi bhavasya ca ' mahaḥ mahataḥ ' rāyaḥ dhanasya ' śaktaṃ samarthau bhavatama |
he ' devau ' vāṃ yuvayoḥ ' mahi mahataḥ pūjyaṃ ' kṣatraṃ balaṃ ' deveṣu prasiddhaṃ stuma iti śeṣaḥ ||
ṛtamṛtena sarpantoṣpirdakṣamāśāte | aduhau devau vardhate || 4 || ṛtam | ṛtena | sarpantā | iṣiram | dakṣam | āśāte iti | aduhau | devau | vardhate iti ||4||
' ṛtena udakena nimittena ' ṛtaṃ yajñaṃ ' sarpantā spṛśantau ' iṣiram eṣaṇavantaṃ ' dakṣaṃ pravṛddhaṃ yajamānaṃ havirvā ' āśāte vyāpnutaḥ |
' aduhau adroghārau ' devau mitrāvaruṇau yuvāṃ ' vardhate pravṛddhau bhavataḥ ||
vṛṣṭidyāvā rityāṃpeṣapatī dānumatyaḥ | bṛhantaṃ gartemāśāte || 5 || vṛṣṭi'dyāvā | riti'āpa | iṣaḥ | patī iti | dānu'matyaḥ | bṛhantam | gartem | āśāte iti || 5 ||

' vṛṣṭidyāvā | ' vṛṣṭyarthā dyauḥ stutiyayorvā ' vṛṣṭidyāvā | athavā ' vṛṣṭirvipikā dyaurantarikṣaṃ yābhyāṃ tāṃ tādṛśau | ' rityāpā || ' rītiḥ prāptiḥ | maiva ' āpā āsiḥ ' abhimata- prāptiryayostau tādṛśau | ' iṣaḥ annasya ' patī svāminau | ' vṛṣṭipradatvāta svāmitvam | ' dānumatyaḥ dānavatyāḥ | ' dātumacitāyāḥ ' ityarthaḥ | etadviśeṣaṇam | evaṃ mahānubhāvau ' bṛhantaṃ mahāntaṃ ' gataṃ ratham ' āśāte vyāpnutaḥ | adhitiṣṭhato yāgārtham || || 6 ||
‘ trī rocanā ’ iti caturṛcaṃ trayodaśaṃ sūktam | ūrucakrirnāmatreya ṛṣiḥ | triṣṭup chandaḥ | mitrāvaruṇau devatā | anukramaṇe ca—‘ trī rocanā catuṣkamurucakriḥ ’ iti | viniyogo laiṅgikaḥ ||
trī ro̭canā varṷṇa trīru॒ta dyūn trīṇi̭ mi॒tra dhā॒raya̭tho ra॒jāmi̭ |
trī | rocanā | varuṇa | trīn | una | yūn | trīṇi | mitra | dhārayathaḥ | rajāṃsi | vāvṛdhānau | amatim | kṣatriyasya | anu | vratam | rakṣamāṇau | ajūryam || 1 ||
he varuṇa he mitra yuvāṃ trī trīṇi rocanā rocanāni dyulokān dhārayatha iti saṃbandhaḥ |
una api ca trīn yūn dyotamānāntarikṣalokān dhārayathaḥ |
rūpaṃ vrataṃ karma ca anaryama ajīrṇamavirataṃ vā rakṣamāṇau ||
i॒rā॒vatī̭varuṇa dhe॒navo̭ vāṃ ma॒dhumdā̭ si॒ndhavo̭ mi॒tra dṷhe |
irā'vatī | varuṇa | dhenavaḥ | vām | madhu'mat | vām | sindhavaḥ | mitra | duhe | trayaḥ | tasthuḥ | vṛṣabhāsaḥ | tisṛṇām | dhiṣaṇānām | retaḥ'dhāḥ | vi | ghumantaḥ || 2 ||
he varuṇa he mitra vāṃ yuvayorjaya dhenavaḥ gāvaḥ irāvatīḥ |
tathā sindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā āpo nadyā vā madhumata madhuramudakaṃ duhe |

tathā trayaḥ trimavyākāḥ vṛṣabhāsaḥ varṣitāraḥ retodhāḥ udakasya dhārakāḥ ghumantaḥ dīptimanto'gni- vāyvādityāḥ tisṛṇāṃ trimavyākānāṃ dhiṣaṇānāṃ sthānānāṃ pṛthivyantarikṣalokānāṃ svāminaḥ santaḥ vi vividhaṃ pratyekaṃ tasthuḥ tiṣṭhanti |
yuvayoranugrahāna trayo'pi devāsriṣu sthāneṣu vartante ityarthaḥ ||
prā॒tarde॒vīṃ ma̭di॒taṃ jo̭havīmi ma॒dhya̭ṃdi॒na udi̭tā॒ sūrya̭sya |
rā॒ye mi॒trāvarṷṇā ma॒rvatā̭te॒ tokā̭ya॒ tana̭yāya śa॒ṃ yoḥ ||
prātaḥ | devīm | aditima | johavīmi | madhyaṃdine | uta | itā | sūryasya | rāye | mitrāvaruṇā | sarva'tātā | tokāya | tanayāya | śam | yoḥ || 3 ||
4. ma-ca-ṇa- ‘ sthānānāṃ... lokānāṃ ’ nāsti ; a-na-na-ma-ra-śa- sthānānāma |
ahamupiḥ ᵥprātaḥ prātaḥkāle ᵥaditim akhaṇḍanīyāṃ devānāṃ jananīṃ ᵥdevīṃ dyotamānāṃ ᵥjohavīmi āhvayāmi |
tathā ᵥmadhyadine ᵥsūryasya ᵥuditā uditau tatsamṛddhikāle mādhyadine savane johavīmi |
he ᵥmitrāvaruṇā yuvāṃ ᵥrāye dhanaprāptaye sarvatāto yajñe ᵥīḻe staumi |
ᵥtokāya putrāya ᵥtanayāya tatputrāya ca ᵥśam ariṣṭaśamanāya ᵥyoḥ sugasya miśraṇāyā ceti ||
yā dhṛtārga rajaso rocanasyotādityā divyā pārthivasya |
na vāṃ devā amṛtā ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi ||
yā | dhṛtārga | rajasaḥ | rocanasya | uta | ādityā | divyā | pārthivasya | na | vām | devāḥ | amṛtāḥ | ā | minanti | vratāni | mitrāvaruṇā | dhruvāṇi || 4 ||
ᵥyā yau ᵥrocanasya rocamānasya ᵥrajasaḥ lokasya |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥpārthi- vasya rajasaḥ yā yau dhṛtārgau ᵥādityā aditeḥ putrau ᵥdivyā divi bhavantau yuvāmīḻe iti pūrvatra sambandhaḥ |
he ᵥmitrāvaruṇā ᵥvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵥdhruvāṇi ᵥvratāni karmāṇi ᵥdevāḥ anye indrādyaḥ ᵥamṛtāḥ amaraṇadharmāṇo'pi ᵥna ᵥā ᵥminanti na hiṃsanti |
‘purūraṇā’ iti caturṛcaṃ caturdaśa sūktamurukairapaṃ gāyatraṃ mitrāvaruṇam |
pṛṣṭhābhiplavaṣaḍahayoḥ prātaḥsavane āvāpārthatvena idamapi sūktaṃ pūrvasūktena saha |
‘pra vo mitrāyeti caturṇāṃ dvitīyamuddharena’ iti uktam |
mūtritaṃ ca— ‘purūraṇā cidrayasi prati vāṃ mūra udite’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 2 ) iti ||
purūraṇā cidrayastyavau nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa | mitra vaṃsi vāṃ sumatim || 1 || purūraṇā | cit | rayiḥ | asti | avaḥ | nūnam | vām | varuṇa | mitra | vaṃsi | vām | sumatim || 1 ||
he mitrāvaruṇau ᵥvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵥpurūraṇā ᵥcit |
athavā puru ca taduru ca purūru |
nāhaka ᵥavaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ ᵥnūnaṃ niścayena ᵥasti |
he ᵥvaruṇa he ᵥmitra ᵥvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵥsumatim anugrahabuddhiṃ ᵥvaṃsi saṃbhajeya |
tā vo̭ su॒mya॒gdu॒ha॒ṇepa̭ma॒śyāma̭ dhā॒yamḙ | va॒yaṃ tḙ ru॒drā syā̭ma || 2 || tā | vām | samyak | adṛhāṇā | iṣam | aśyāma | dhāyase | vayam | te | rudrā | syāma ||2||
he adṛhāṇā he adṛgdhārau tā tau prasiddhau vāṃ yuvāṃ samyak |
stotāro vayam iṣam annaṃ dhāyase pānāya bhojanāya aśyāma prāpnuyāma |
he rudrā duḥkhān drāvayitārau rudriḥ' dravaṇīyā~ vā te stotāraḥ vayaṃ syāma bhavema |
pā॒taṃ naṷ ru॒drā pā॒yubhi̭ru॒ta trā॒yethā̭ṃ su॒trātrā̭ | tu॒ryā̭ma॒ dasya̭ntū॒rbhi̭ḥ || 3 || pātam | naḥ | rudrā | pāyubhiḥ | uta | trāyethām | sutrātrā | turyāma | dasyan | tūrbhiḥ ||3||
he rudrā ukta rūpau devau yuvāṃ naḥ asmān pāyubhiḥ rakṣaṇaiḥ pātaṃ rakṣatam |
uta api ca sutrātrā śobhanena trāṇena trāyethāṃ pālayathām |
stotrādi- vaikalyāt śatrorvā trāyethām abhimataprāpaṇena rakṣatamityarthaḥ |
vayaṃ ca tūrbhiḥ putrādibhiḥ sahitāḥ svairvā dasyan śatrūn turyāma hiṃsyāma tarema vā ||
mā ka॒syā̭da॒takra̭tu॒ yakṣa̭ṃ bhu॒ṃjemā̭ ta॒nūbhi̭: | mā śe॒ṣā mā ta॒na̭sā || 4 || mā | kasya | adbhutakratu | yakṣam | bhuṃjema | tanūbhiḥ | mā | śeṣasā | mā | tanasā ||4||
he adbhutakratu āścaryakarmāṇau vayaṃ kasya anyasya kasyacana yakṣaṃ pūjitaṃ dhanaṃ mā bhuṃjema mā bhuṃjīmahi tanūbhiḥ asmadīyaiḥ avayavaiḥ |
yuvayoranugrahāta samṛddhā vayam anyācitadhanena śarīrapoṣaṇaṃ na kurma ityarthaḥ |
tathā śeṣasā apatyena sahitāḥ mā bhuṃjema |
‘ā no gantam’ iti tṛcātmakaṃ pañcadaśaṃ sūktaṃ vāyudṛṣṭasyātreyasyārṣaṃ gāyatraṃ maitrāvaruṇam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā no mitrāvaruṇā no gantaṃ riśādasā’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 10) iti ||
ā naṷ ga॒ntaṃ ri̭śāda॒sā varṷṇa mi॒tra ba॒rhaṇā̭ | u॒pema̭ṃ cā॒ruma̭dhva॒ram || 1 || ā | naḥ | gantam | riśādasā | varuṇa | mitra | barhaṇā | upa | imam | cārum | adhvaram ||1||
he ᵥvaruṇa he ᵥmitra he ᵥriśādasā śatrūṇāṃ prerakau yuvāṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākam ᵥhyaṃ ᵥcāruṃ caraṇīyam ᵥadhvaram ahiṃsakaṃ yajñam ᵥupa ᵥā ᵥgantam upāgacchatam |
viśvasya hi pracetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ |
viśvasya | hi | pra'cetasā | varuṇa | mitra | rājathaḥ | īśānā | pipyatam | dhiyaḥ || 2 ||
he ᵥmitra he ᵥvaruṇa ᵥpracetamā prakṛṣṭajñānau yuvāṃ ᵥviśvasya ᵥrājathaḥ sarvasya svāminau bhavataḥ |
he ᵥīśānā asmākamīśvarau yuvāṃ ᵥdhiyaḥ asmadīyāni karmāṇi ᵥpipyataṃ pyāyataṃ phalaiḥ ||
vratena stho dhruvakṣemā dharmmaṇā yā tayajjanā |
vratena | sthaḥ | dhruvakṣemā | dharmmaṇā | yā tayajjanā | ni | barhiṣi | sadatam | somapītaye || 2 ||
he mitrāvaruṇau yuvāṃ dharmmaṇā jagaddhārakeṇa vratena karmmaṇā yāṃgena dhruvakṣemā sthaḥ |
yā tayantaḥ karmmasu pravarttayanto janā ṛtvijo yayostau yā tayajanī |
athavā yā tayantaḥ śatrūn hiṃmanto janā bhṛtyā yayostau |
mitraḥ | ca | naḥ | varuṇaḥ | ca | juṣetām | yajñam | iṣṭaye | ni | barhiṣi | sadatām | somapītaye || 3 ||
mitraśca varuṇaśca ubhau naḥ asmākaṃ yajñam iṣṭaye abhīṣṭāya juṣetāṃ sevetām |
āgatya ca barhiṣi ni sadatāṃ niṣī

iha tyā purubhūtamā puru daṃsāṃsi bibhraṃtā | varasyā yāmyādhriṃgū huve tuviṣṭamā bhuje || 2 || iha | tyā | puru'bhūtamā | puru | daṃsāṃsi | bibhraṃtā | varasyā | yāmi | adhriṃgū ityādi'gū | huve | tuviḥ'tamā | bhuje || 2 ||

^iha asmin yajñe ^tyā tau ^purubhūtamā puruṇāṃ bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ bhāvayitṛtamau ^puru puruṇi ^daṃsāṃsi karmāṇi ^bibhraṃtā dhārayantau ^varasyā varaṇīyau ^adhriṃgū anyaiḥ aṣṭagamanakarmāṇau ^yāmi upāgacchāmi |

īrmānyadvapuṣe vapuścakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ | paryaṃnyā nāhūṣā yugā mahā rajāṃsi dīyathaḥ || 3 || īrmā | anyat | vapuṣe | vapuḥ | ^cakram | rathasya | yemathuḥ | pari | anyā | nāhūṣā | yugā | mahā | rajāṃsi | dīyathaḥ || 3 ||
gantavyāditye ^vapuṣe tasya śābhāyai ^vapuḥ vapuṣmat tejovat cakraṃ ^yemathuḥ niyamitavantau sthaḥ |
teṣāṃ yugā yugopalakṣitān kālān prātarādimavanān ahorātrādikālān vā ^rajāṃsi lokāṃśca ^pari ^dīyathaḥ parigacchathaḥ |
^‘nya16yasya mūrdhani cakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ 1. 30. 10) ityuktam ||

tadū ṣu vāmenā kṛtaṃ viśvā yadāmanu eve | nānā jātāvarepasā samasme bandhumeyathuḥ || 4 || tat | ū~ iti | su | vām | enā | kṛtam | viśvā | yat | vām | anu | stavai | nānā | jātā | arepasā | sam | asme iti | bandhum | ā | īyathuḥ || 4 ||
he ^viśvā vyāptau ^yat yena stotreṇa ^vāṃ yuvām ^anu ^eve anustuve ^tadu |
^enā anena paureṇa ^su^ su ^vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ ^kṛtaṃ saṃpāditaṃ bhavatu |
^nānā pṛthageva ^jātau samṛddhau ^arepasā apāpau ^asme asmabhyaṃ ^bandhum annaṃ dhanaṃ vā ^mam ^ā ^īyathuḥ samyak gamayathaḥ |

ā yadvāṃ sūryā rathaṃ tiṣṭhathuṣpadaṃ sadā | pariṃ vāmarupā vayau ghṛṇā varanta ātapaḥ || 5 || ā | yat | vām | sūryā | ratham | tiṣṭhat | raghupyadam | sadā | pari | vām | aruṣāḥ | vayaḥ | ghṛṇā | varante | ātapaḥ || 5 ||
he aśvinau ^vāṃ yuvayoḥ ^sadā ^sarvadā ^raghupyadaṃ śīghraga rathaṃ ^sūryā yuvayoḥ patnī ^yata yadā ^ā ^tiṣṭhat āsthitavatī tadā ^vāṃ ^pari ^varante parito vṛṇvanti |
vayau gantāra uktalakṣaṇā ātapaḥ sarvatamāpayiṣyo dīsayaḥ pari varante ||

yuvoratriṃ ciketati narāṃ sumena cetasā | gharmaṃ yadvāmarepasaṃ nāsatyānnā bhuraṇyati || 6 || yuvoḥ | atriḥ | ciketati | narā | sumena | cetasā | gharmam | yat | vām | arepasam | nāsatyā | ānnā | bhuraṇyati || 6 ||
^atriḥ asmatpitā ṛṣiḥ ^sumena sukhena agnidāhopaśamarūpeṇa hantunā ^cetayā ādarayuktena manamā ^ciketati jānāti |
'yat yasmān he' nāsatyau ^vāṃ yuvayoḥ ^ānnā āsyena tajjihvena ^stotreṇa ^gharmaṃ dīsaṃ dahantamagnimasuraḥ svadāhāya prakṣisam ^arepasam apāpaṃ sukhakaraṃ ^bhuraṇyati prāptavān ||
atraigmeḥ makāśāna rakṣaṇaṃ 'himenāgniṃ ghaṃmam' (ṛ. saṃ 1. 116. 8 ), ^yuvamṛvā~samuta tasamatraye ^(ṛ. maṃ. 10. 39. 7 ) ityādibhiḥ spaṣṭaṃ pradarśitam ||

ugro vāṃ kakuho yayiḥ śṛṇve yāmeṣu maṃtuniḥ | yadvāṃ daṃsobhiraśvinātrirnarātravartati || 7 || ugraḥ | vām | kakuhaḥ | yayiḥ | śṛṇve | yāmeṣu | samu'taniḥ | yat | vām | daṃsobhiḥ | aśvinā | atriḥ | narā | ā'vartati || 7 ||
ugra: ugrabala: vāṃ yuvāṃ: kukuha: ucchito mahān yayi: gantā saṃtani: yatataṃ gacchan ratha: yāmeṣu gamaneṣu yajñeṣu vā śrṛṇve śrūyate |
ha aśvinā ha narā yata yasmāt vāṃ yuvāṃ daṃsobhi: karmabhi: agni: asmasmitā ādavarneni āvartayati ||

madhvaṃ ū ṣu madhvayuvā rudrā sirsakti pipyuṣīṃ | yatsamudrāti parṣatha: pakkā: pṛkṣo bharanta vām || 8 || madhva: | ū iti | su | madhvayuvā | rudrā | sirsakti | pipyuṣīṃ | yat | samudrā | ati | parṣatha: | pakkā: | pṛkṣa: | bharanta | vām || 8 ||
ha madhvayuvā madhurasya somāde ( madhvāyitāro ha rudrā |
tayā dravaṇyāṃ rudraputrau vā vāṃ madhva: madhurasena mu pipyuṣī suṣṭhu pyāyayantī stutirmā kṛtā mipanti sevate |
yana yadā samudrā samudravaṇamāpnanāni antarikṣāṇi ati parṣatha: atipārayatha: |
pakkā: pṛkṣa: annāni havirlakṣaṇāni vāṃ bharanta śriyante yajamānai: ||

satyamidvā u aśvinā yuvāmāhurmayobhuvā | tā yāmanyāmuhartamā yāmanā mṛḻayattamā || 9 || satyam | it | vai | ū iti | aśvinā | yuvām | āhu: | maya:'bhuvā | tā | yāman | yāma'hūtamā | yāman | ā | mṛḻayat'tamā || 9 ||

yāmana ammayajñe ammadardhāgamane vā mṛḻayattamā cātiśayena sukhayitārau avatam |

imā brahmāṇi vardhanāśvibhyāṃ mantu śaṃtamā | yā takṣām rathā~ivāvaucāma bṛhanmarma: || 10 || imā | brahmāṇi | vardhanā | adhi'bhyām | santu | śama'tamā | yā | takṣām | rathā~'iva | avaucāma | bṛhat | narma: || 10 ||

imā imāni idānīṃ kṛtāni brahmāṇi paribṛḍhāni stotrāṇi aśvibhyāṃ vardhanā vardhanāni samarthakāni śaṃsatamā sukhatamāni mantu |
yā yāni takṣāma saṃpādayāma rathāniva śilpī tattakṣāma tāni santu |
vayaṃ vṛhat prabhūtaṃ prabhūtaphalapradaṃ namaḥ namaskāroktim avācāma ||

kūṣṭau devāśvinādyā divo manā vasū | tacchravatho vṛṣaṇvasū atrirvāmā vivāsāti || 1 || kūṣṭaḥ | devau | aśvinā | atha | divaḥ | manā vasū iti | tat | śravathaḥ | vṛṣaṇvasū iti vṛṣaṇvasū | atriḥ | vāma | ā | vivāsāti || 1 ||
he devau he manā vasū stutidhanā aśvinā atha asmin yāgadine divaḥ dyulokāta āgatya kṛṣṭaḥ |
kau bhūmau tiṣṭhanto mantau tat stotraṃ śravathaḥ śṛṇutam |
he vṛṣaṇvasū varṣadhanau vām atriḥ atreḥ putraḥ ā vivāsati sarvataḥ paricarati ||
athavā kṛ ityasya nipātasya stha ityākhyātena ‘saha’ iti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ |
‘arāhava’ (ṛ. saṃ. 5. 58. 5) ityatra yathavaśabdaḥ, ‘kṛcijñāyate’ (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 4. 5), ‘kṛcitsantam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 93. 11) ityādivadapi draṣṭavyam ||

he devau yuvāṃ kasmin jane yaja- māne ā yatathaḥ āgacchathaḥ |
kaḥ stotā vāṃ yuvayoḥ nadīnāṃ stutīnāṃ sacā sahāyaḥ syāt ||

kaṃ yāthaḥ kaṃ he gacchathaḥ kamacchā yuñjāthe ratham | kasya brahmāṇi raṇyatho vayaṃ vāmuśmasīṣṭaye || 3 || kam | yāthaḥ | kam | ha | gacchathaḥ | kam | accha | yuñjāthe iti | ratham | kasya | brahmāṇi | raṇyathaḥ | vayam | vām | uśmasi | iṣṭaye || 3 ||

gatvā ca kena saha saṃgato bhavataḥ |
kaṃ ca accha abhiprāptuṃ yuñjāthe yojayathaḥ |
kasya brahmāṇi parigṛḍhāni stotrāṇi raṇyathaḥ ramethe |
vayaṃ ca vāṃ yuvām iṣṭaye gamanāyeṣaṇāya vā uśmasi kāmayāmahe tasmānna kasya cana yāgaṃ prati na gantavyamityarthaḥ ||
pauraṃ cidyudaprutaṃ paura paugāya jinvathaḥ | yadīṃ gṛbhītatāṃtaye siṃhamiva drahaspude || 4 || pauram | cit | hi | uda

asti hi vāṃmiha stotā smasiṃ vāṃ suṃdarśa śriye | nu śrutaṃ ma ā gaṃtamavorbhivājinīvam || 6 || asti | hi | vām | iha | stotā | smasi | vām | su'darśa | śriye | nu | śrutam | me | ā | gatam | arveḥ'bhiḥ | vājinīvasū iti vājinīva'vasū || 6 ||

he devau vvāṃ vsuṃdarśa sudarśane sannidhā
stotā vāmaśvināvṛṣiḥ stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
prati | priyatamam | ratham | vṛṣaṇam | vasuvāhanam | stātā | vām | aśvinau | ṛṣiḥ | stomena | prati | bhūṣati | mādhvī iti | mama | śrutam | havam || 1 ||
vāṃ yuvayoḥ priyatamaṃ rathaṃ stotā ṛṣiḥ avasyuḥ stomena prati bhūṣati alaṃkāroti |
vṛṣaṇaṃ varṣitāraṃ phalānāṃ vasuvāhanaṃ dhanānāṃ vāhakam |
tasmāna he mādhvī madhuvidyāveditāgau mama havam āhvānaṃ śrutaṃ śṛṇutam ||
dastrā hiraṇyavartanī subhuṃmā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||

yathā aham ṛṣiḥ viśvāḥ sarvā asmadvirodhiprajāḥ manā madā tiraskaromi |
athavā'haṃ tiraḥ tiraḥ mata iti prāptasya ( niru. 3. 20 ) iti niruktam |
prāptā viśvāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā yuṣmadīyāḥ anuṣṭheyamityarthaḥ |
sanā sanātanau dastrā śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitārau hiraṇyavartanī hiraṇyarathau susumnā sindhuvāhamā nardānāṃ pravāhayitārau vṛṣṭipreraṇena |
ā no ratnāni bibhratāvāśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam |
rudrā hiraṇyavartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
ā | naḥ | ratnāni | bibhratau | aśvinau | gacchatam | yuvam | rudrā | hiraṇyavartanī iti hiraṇya'vartanī | juṣāṇā | vājinīvasū iti vājinī'vasū | mādhvī iti | mama | śrutam | havam || 3 ||
he aśvinā na: asmabhyaṃ ratnāni ramaṇīyāni dhanāni bibhratau dhārayantau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ no'smān vā ā gacchatam |
ha rudrā rudraputrau stutyau vā ha vājinīvasū vājinadhanau yuvāṃ hiraṇyavartanī hiraṇyarathau jupāṇā yajñaṃ sevamānau santau ā gacchatamiti |
uta vāṃ kakuho mṛgaḥ pṛkṣaḥ kṛṇoti vāpuṣā mādhvī marma śrutaṃ havam ||

vayo vahantu pītaye maha sumnebhiraśvinā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam ||
ā | vām | narā | manaḥ'yujaḥ | adhvāsaḥ | pṛṣita'psavaḥ | vayaḥ | vahantu | pītaye | saha | sumnebhiḥ | aśvinā | mādhvī iti | mama | śrutam | havam || 6 ||

aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam |

yasmādevaṃ tasmāt he rathā rathasvāmināvaśvinau arvāñcā asmadabhimukhāśvinau nūnam adyāsmin yāgadine iha ā yātam |
pīpivāṃsaṃ svāṅgaiḥ? parivṛḍhaṃ gharmaṃ pradīptaṃ yajñam |
athavā ṛtādinā pīpivāṃsaṃ gharmaṃ pravargyam accha abhilakṣya iha yātam |
na saṃskṛtaṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭhā nūnamaśvinopastuteha |
na | saṃskṛtam | pra | mimītaḥ | gamiṣṭhā | anti | nūnam | aśvinau | upa'stutā | iha | divā | abhipitve | avasā | ā'gamiṣṭhā | prati | avartim | dāśuṣe | śam'bhaviṣṭhā ||2||
aśvinau saṃskṛtaṃ gharmaṃ na pra mimītaḥ na hiṃsām |
kintu anti antike gharmamamīpe nūnam idānīm iha yajñe gamiṣṭhā gantṛtamau aśvinā aśvinau upastutā upastutau bhavataḥ |
divābhipitve divasasyābhipatane prātaḥkāle avasā rakṣaṇena saha āgamiṣṭhā āgantṛtamau |
āgatya ca dāśuṣe havirdanavate yajamānāya śaṃbhaviṣṭhā sukhasya bhāvayitārau bhavatām ||
utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātarahau mṛṣyaṃdinaṃ uditā sūryasya |
divā naktamavasā śaṃtamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna ||
uta | ā | yātam | sam'gave | prātaḥ | ahaḥ | madhyaṃdine | ut'ītā | sūryasya | divā | naktam | avasā | śam'tamena | na | idānīm | pītiḥ | aśvinau | ā | tatāna ||3||
aho dvedhā tredhā pañcadhā pañcadaśadhā samānāḥ vibhāgāḥ santi |
uta api ca ā yātam āgacchatam |
saṃgacchante gāvo dohabhūmiṃ yasmin kāle sa saṃgavaḥ |
rātryaparakāle hi gāvāṃ vane himatṛṇāni bhakṣayitvā punardodhāya saṃgave pratinivartante |
tathā madhyaṃdine ahaḥ madhyakāle sūryasya uditā uditau abhyudaye atyantapravṛddhasamaye aparāhṇe ityarthaḥ |

ukteṣveva kāleṣu kiṃ tarhi ? divā naktaṃ sarvadā śaṃtamena sukhatamena avasā rakṣaṇena haviṣā vā nimittena ā yātam |
idānīm api vītiḥ itaradevānāṃ pānaṃ na ā tanāna na tanoti aśvinā aśvinau vihāyeti śeṣaḥ ||
idaṃ hi vāṃ pradivi sthānamorka ime gṛhā aśvinedaṃ duroṇam |
ā nau divo bṛhataḥ parvatādāśvayo yātamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā ||
idam | hi | vām | pra'divi | sthānam | orkaḥ | ime | gṛhāḥ | aśvinā | idam | duroṇam | ā | naḥ | divaḥ | bṛhataḥ | parvatāt | ā | at'imyaḥ | yātam | iṣam | ūrjam | vahantā || 4 ||
ha aśvinā vāṃ yuvayoḥ pradivi purāṇam idaṃ hi okaḥ nivāsayogyaṃ sthānam uttaravedyākhyam |
naḥ asmadarthaṃ divaḥ dyulokāt bṛhataḥ parvatāt parvatato meghāt aśvaḥ apāṃ kāraṇādantarikṣāt ā yātam āgacchatam |
ā nau rayiṃ vahatamūta vīṟānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni ||
sam | aśvinauḥ | avasā | nūtanena | mayaḥ'bhuvā | su'praṇītī | gamema | ā | naḥ | rayim | vahatam | ā | uta | vīṟān | ā | viśvāni | amṛtā | saubhagāni ||5||
vayaṃ saṃ gamema saṃgacchema aśvināḥ nūtanena avamā ananyakṛtena rakṣaṇena mayobhuvā sukhasya bhāvayitvā supraṇītā supraṇītyā suṣṭhāgamanena ca |
he amṛtā amaradharmāṇau viśvāni saubhagāni subhagatvāni ā vahatam ||
‘prātaryāvāṇā’ iti pañca ca pañcamaṃ sūktamātrayaṃ traiṣṭubhamāśvinam |
tathā ca sūtritam—‘prātaryāvāṇā kṣetrasya pate madhumantamūrjam’ (ādha. śrau. 9. 11) iti ||
prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yaṃjadhvaṃ purā gṛdhradaruṣaḥ pibātaḥ |
prātarhi yajñamaśvinā dadhāte pra śaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ ||
prātaḥ | ryāvāṇā | prathamā | yajvam | purā | gṛdhrāt | aruṣaḥ | pibātaḥ | prātaḥ | hi | yajñam | aśvinā | dadhāte iti | pra | śaṃsanti | kavayaḥ | pūrvabhājaḥ || 1 ||
he madīyā ṛtvijaḥ 'prātaryāvāṇā prātareva yajñaṃ gantārau' 'prathamā ata evaṃtarebhyo devebhyaḥ pūrvabhāvinau prakṛṣṭamau vā aśvinau 'yajadhvam |
'ye vā anucānānte kavayaḥ ' (ai. brā. 2. 38) iti hi nigamaḥ ||
prātaryajvamaśvinā hinota na sāyamasti devayā arjuṣṭam |
utānyo asmadyajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥpūrvoṃ yajamāno vanīyān ||
prātaḥ | yajvam | aśvinā | hinota | na | sāyam | asti | devayāḥ | arjuṣṭam | uta | anyaḥ | asmat | yajate | vi | ca | āvaḥ | pūrvaḥ | pūrvaḥ | yajamānaḥ | vanīyān ||2||
he madīyāḥ puruṣāḥ 'aśvinā aśvinau 'prātaḥ prātareva 'yajadhvaṃ pūjayadhvaṃ studhvam |
'uta 'asmat asmat 'anyaḥ ko'pi 'yajate yajeta momena 'vi 'cāvaḥ vitarpayecca haviṣā |
ato'smāsvanyeṣu ca madhye 'pūrvaḥ pūrvo yajamānaḥ yaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo yaṣṭā bhavati saḥ 'vanīyān devānāṃ saṃbhajanāyaḥ saṃbhāgyo bhavati ||

ᵥvāṃ yuvayoḥ ᵥrathaḥ ᵥpṛkṣaḥ annamamṛtaṃ ᵥvahan ᵥā ᵥvartate asmadabhimukhamāgacchati |
ᵥhiraṇyatvak hiraṇyācchāditarūpaḥ ᵥhiraṇyāvṛtaḥ ᵥmadhuvarṇaḥ manoharavarṇaḥ ᵥghṛtasnuḥ udakasya prasnavanaḥ ᵥmanāṃjavāḥ manovegaḥ ᵥvātaraṃhāḥ vātasadṛśavegaḥ |
